Als Process Automation Engineer speel je een cruciale rol in het hart van onze productieomgeving. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het beheren, onderhouden en continu verbeteren van het procesautomatiseringslandschap (ISA‑niveaus 1, 2 en 3 – zowel hardware als software).

Je borgt de betrouwbaarheid en beschikbaarheid van onze productieprocessen en vertaalt data en technologie naar slimme, praktische verbeteringen die de organisatie vooruithelpen. Dit is een hands‑on functie met veel impact, waarin je nauw samenwerkt met Operations, Production Support Engineering en externe technologiepartners.

Bedrijfsomschrijving

NX Filtration bevindt zich in een spannende groeifase, gedreven door een unieke en impactvolle technologie. Met onze missie “pure en betaalbare wateroplossingen voor iedereen” ontwikkelen en produceren wij geavanceerde holle‑vezelmembranen voor nano‑, ultra‑ en microfiltratie.

Onze technologie verwijdert de kleinste verontreinigingen uit water, waaronder nanoplastics, organische stoffen, kleurstoffen, medicijnresten, bacteriën en virussen. Hiermee maken wij eenvoudige, efficiënte en duurzame oplossingen mogelijk voor waterzuivering, hergebruik van afvalwater en drinkwaterproductie wereldwijd. Door bij NX Filtration te werken, draag je direct bij aan het oplossen van mondiale uitdagingen op het gebied van waterkwaliteit en waterschaarste.

title: Product Manager
description:
Role summary

Bluerock TMS builds the autonomous orchestration platform that keeps global logistics moving — orchestrating complex, multi-modal transport networks for customers across fashion, food & beverage, manufacturing, healthcare, and more. Real complexity, at real scale, every single day.

We're looking for a Product Manager who has actually lived inside logistics or TMS operations. Someone who can understand operations complexity and who is willing to take on this challenge and contribute hands on to build the next level of TMS. You'll own the products that turn that complexity into clarity, working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering, sales, and implementation to make sure what we build actually gets adopted.

Responsibilities

  • Product vision, grounded in real user needs

You dig past what customers ask for to find the problem underneath, and turn that into a direction for your area the company can rally behind.

  • Market scoping and opportunity-spotting

Scanning the logistics landscape, competitor moves, and customer signals to find where Bluerock should build next, not just what's already on the backlog.

  • Logistics know-how turned into product decisions 

Planning, transport execution, freight, last-mile — decisions that hold up against how operations actually run, not just how they're described to you.

title: Stage lopen bij Cordaan: Je opleiding in de praktijk
description:
Cordaan biedt zorg binnen en buiten Amsterdam aan en wil zich onderscheiden als leerbedrijf. Wij hebben voor diverse beroepsopleidingen in de zorg een stageplek op maat. Dus ook voor jou! 

Er is veel aandacht voor je persoonlijke ontwikkeling en we zorgen voor een gedegen begeleiding. Na je sollicitatie zoeken we samen met het opleidingsbureau naar de beste stageplek. We houden rekening met je voorkeuren zoals de cliëntengroep (Ouderenzorg, Gehandicaptenzorg, Jeugd, GGZ/LVB+, Zorg in de wijk of in Wonen Werk & Dagbesteding).
Overigens vinden wij het niet alleen belangrijk dat jij leert van ons, wij willen ook leren van jou! Als student breng je tenslotte ook kennis, vaardigheden en nieuwe inzichten mee en daarmee doen wij ons voordeel. Zo werkt het twee kanten op.

Maatschappelijke stages
We organiseren ook maatschappelijke stages (snuffelstage, MaS stage) voor middelbare scholieren, die bij ons kunnen leren wat vrijwilligerswerk inhoudt. Je kan met deze vraag het beste contact opnemen met een vrijwilligerscoördinator. Ga naar https://www.cordaan.nl/vrijwilligers of neem contact op met het servicepunt informele zorg via Bij Cordaan krijgt iedereen de kans om tot bloei te komen. Ben je onder de 40? Sluit je dan aan bij Jong Cordaan, dé club die jongere medewerkers bij Cordaan een stem geeft. Zo mag je bijvoorbeeld meedenken over actuele thema’s. En met de uitkomsten gaat Cordaan echt aan de slag. Ook organiseert Jong Cordaan regelmatig gezellige netwerkborrels waar je andere young professionals kunt ontmoeten.


Contact met het opleidingsbureau?
Je kunt je aanmelden door te solliciteren en de vragen in te vullen, CV en motivatie toe te voegen.

title: Senior interim manager in de zorg in loondienst
description:
Ben jij een ervaren leider die energie krijgt van het aanbrengen van structuur in uitdagende situaties? Hou je ervan om orde op zaken te stellen en daarna door te gaan naar de volgende interne opdracht? Word jij blij van de afwisseling en uitdaging van een projectmatige rol en met de zekerheid en voordelen van een baan in loondienst? Dan is deze rol als interim manager bij Cordaan iets voor jou! 

Wat ga je doen? 
Als interim manager word je ingezet op locaties van Cordaan waar extra leiderschap en verandering nodig zijn. Dit betekent dat je tijdelijke projectmatige opdrachten uitvoert in de organisatie, waar je snel schakelt, structuur aanbrengt en teams in crisis helpt stabiliseren. Je start elke opdracht met het maken van een projectplan en zorgt dat dit succesvol wordt uitgevoerd. Je zorgt ervoor dat medewerkers optimaal kunnen functioneren en kwalitatieve zorg kunnen bieden. 

Jouw belangrijkste taken: 

  • Leidinggeven in complexe situaties: Je biedt duidelijkheid, hakt knopen door en creëert een veilige en gestructureerde werkomgeving. 

  • Verandermanagement: Je begeleidt afdelingen in transitie en zorgt voor blijvende verbeteringen in zorgkwaliteit en teamdynamiek. 

  • Bedrijfsvoering op orde brengen: Je monitort en rapporteert maandelijks over financiën, medewerkerstevredenheid en verloop. 

  • Samenwerking versterken: Je betrekt vrijwilligers, mantelzorgers en familieleden bij het welzijn van cliënten.

title: Senior Embedded Software Test Engineer
description:

Your scope covers the integrated behavior of embedded Linux applications and services, internal and external APIs, hardware interfaces, firmware and FPGA interactions, system control, calibration and configuration, diagnostics, data acquisition, boot and update behavior, recovery mechanisms, and sensor interfaces. You build and maintain automated test frameworks, HIL benches, test harnesses, CI/CD integration, and objective release evidence that make product behavior repeatable, observable, and measurable.

You are part of the Sensing Platform Team and work closely with Embedded Software, FPGA/Firmware, Electronics, Photonics, Architects, Product System Engineering, Product Integration, Verification & Validation, Lifecycle Engineering, application/software teams, and external development partners. The primary ownership of this role is integrated interrogator/HIL system-level testing and release qualification. It complements developer-owned unit and component testing and does not replace independent formal verification, compliance, environmental, or end-to-end application validation performed downstream.

title: Senior System Test & Validation Engineer
description:

You develop a strong understanding of the product, customer use cases, system architecture, operating environment, and technical risks, and translate these into effective validation strategies, test setups, and test campaigns.

The systems you validate combine sensing hardware, embedded software, Edge computing, networking, cloud software, data processing, algorithms, and customer-facing applications. Your role is therefore focused on validating the complete system and ensuring that critical customer workflows work reliably before release.

You work closely with Product, Systems Engineering, Software, Embedded, Hardware, Algorithms, Operations, Manufacturing, and other IVVQ engineers.

This is a senior hands-on individual contributor role, combining system-level thinking, test design, technical investigation, and practical validation.


Qualifications

  • BSc or MSc in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, Embedded Systems, Physics, or a related technical discipline.

  • 7+ years of relevant experience in system testing, verification & validation, integration testing, or product qualification.

  • Strong understanding of system-level test strategy, risk-based testing, requirements verification, and product qualification.

  • Experience translating requirements and customer use cases into practical validation approaches.

  • Experience designing system test setups and representative test environments.

OpenAI’s Applied AI Engineering team helps organizations turn frontier AI capabilities into safe, reliable, and high-impact production systems. We work with customer executives, product and engineering teams, security leaders, and transformation teams to identify valuable opportunities, accelerate technical implementation, and scale what works.

Production-ready deployments are defined by complexity rather than any one industry: existing architectures, diverse data environments, security and governance requirements, multiple stakeholder groups, and organization-wide change. We turn lessons from these deployments into better products and reusable patterns for customers everywhere.

As an Applied AI Engineer you will partner directly with leading organizations to design, build, and deploy AI systems that deliver measurable business outcomes. You will combine deep technical judgment, hands-on engineering, and customer leadership to take ambitious ideas from use-case selection and architecture through prototyping, evaluation, production launch, and scale.

You will write and debug code, build evaluation systems, resolve complex integrations, and guide decisions involving model behavior, reliability, latency, cost, safety, security, governance, and operational readiness. Success is measured by production systems, sustained adoption, and meaningful customer impact—not simply activity or successful demonstrations.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (f/m/d)

About Valova

We are building the AI operations platform for European hospitals, so every clinician can focus on patients.

Behind every patient sits a chain of admin work: documentation, coding, billing, audits, scheduling. It runs through disconnected systems and endless manual hand-offs, while most German hospitals already operate at a loss.

We start where the impact is measurable from day one: case to cash. Valova codes every case, defends it in audits and makes sure the money lands. From there we take on every workflow that runs a hospital, until one agentic system handles the routine and people decide the exceptions. First Germany, then Europe.

Doctors, engineers and operators, on-site in Munich and Berlin. Join us!

Why this role matters

Valova only works as well as it fits into the hospital. Our product creates the most value when it’s deeply connected to a hospital’s systems and built around how coders and medical controlling actually work. Today, connecting to a hospital information system can take months. That’s time hospitals keep losing revenue and coders keep working by hand.

That’s where you come in. As Forward Deployed Engineer, you own technical go-lives from start to finish: from the first sandbox to production, from the interface to the workflow on the ward. You’re the bridge between hospital IT, the people who use Valova and our engineering team.

Your impact is easy to see: in hospitals that go live faster, in integrations that run reliably, and in a product that gets better with every deployment because you bring back what you learn.

This is a hands-on engineering role with real code in production and direct influence on our roadmap. It’s not a support desk, not a pre-sales role and not project management

The kind of work

The following are representative of current and upcoming engagements. Individual roles will draw on some of this, not all of it — we are more interested in engineers who can work confidently at the intersection of Java and data than in a checklist match against any one programme.

Secure data catalogue and access-control platform

A greenfield metadata catalogue acting as a federated index over data held across independent domains, so that authorised parties can locate and retrieve data the catalogue itself never holds. The work includes designing an attribute-based access control model over attributes such as clearance, nationality, organisational unit and compartment; enforcing those policies inside the database query path rather than filtering results afterwards; application-layer encryption with externally managed keys; hybrid lexical and semantic search with access filtering applied before candidate retrieval rather than after it; and a tamper-evident audit trail that can reconstruct why a given record was returned, redacted or withheld.

title: Software engineer, AI model supply chain and package security
description:
We build fast, modern developer tools in Rust, and a surprising amount of serious software runs on them. Pixi, rattler and rattler-build are open source and used by hundreds of thousands of developers: quant teams in finance, physicists at CERN, biotech labs, and humanoid robot companies you've probably seen videos of. We are also core maintainers of conda-forge, one of the largest open source package ecosystems, and we maintain RoboStack, which gets ROS running on any OS from a single lockfile.

When that much software flows through your tools, security stops being optional. Every package that ends up on a laptop, a server or a robot should be traceable back to the source and build that produced it. We're building that for conda today, and we want to extend it to AI models.

The engineering team is spread across Europe (Netherlands, Germany, UK, Moldova). This work is based in Berlin, and so is this role.

The work

Robots increasingly run learned models: vision transformers, RL policies, LLMs. Today those models are usually copied onto machines as large opaque files, with little record of where they came from or what changed. We think models should be shipped like packages: versioned, signed, verifiable, and updated efficiently.

You'll work on two related areas.

Package security. Signing and verification for conda packages with Sigstore, provenance from source to build to install, SBOMs, and mapping known vulnerabilities onto the packages people actually use. This work goes into Pixi, rattler and conda-forge, and is used by a lot of people.

AI models as packages. Taking the same ideas to model artifacts. That includes:

  • Zich wil ontwikkelen binnen een commercieel gerichte en/of consultingomgeving

title: Senior developer Novulo
description:
Wil jij samen met ons de verzekeringssector transformeren? Ben je toe aan een uitdaging waarin je echt het verschil kan maken? Heb jij kennis van softwareontwikkeling, Low Code en digitale transformaties? Dan is dit dé uitdaging voor jou. Is jouw technische kennis de ontbrekende schakel voor onze scale-up binnen IG&H. Samen bouwen we de Insurance solution van de toekomst!

Als Senior Novulo Developer help jij onze klanten binnen Financial Services processen optimaliseren met behulp van het Novulo platform. Dit platform stelt ons in staat om de bedrijfsprocessen van onze klanten te automatiseren, te ontsluiten via API’s en te digitaliseren. Je krijgt training van onze Novulo experts en gaat samen met jouw collega’s de ontwikkelreis aan! Door jouw development kennis zal jij dit snel eigen maken.

Op inhoud ondersteun je bij het ontwerpen en ontwikkelen van onze solutions. Je denkt mee over de juiste compositie en werkt in multidisciplinaire IG&H teams samen, om organisaties te helpen te veranderen!  

Wij zoeken iemand die:

  •          Kennis heeft van ontwikkelen (low code, C#. .NET, Outsystems, Mendix of vergelijkbaar);

  •          Eigenaarschap, energie en drive om de mooiste solutions te bouwen,

title: Senior Consultant RELEX
description:
Ben jij een consultant met supply chain én RELEX kennis, die op zoek is naar meer impact, verantwoordelijkheid en ruimte om echt het verschil te maken bij toonaangevende retailers? Wil jij werken in een organisatie waar technologie, verandermanagement en samenwerking samenkomen? Dan is dit jouw kans.

Met meer dan 500 collega’s die verandering omarmen, hebben we een unieke cultuur van “high-daring, high-caring” opgebouwd. Wij geloven in gelijkwaardigheid, innovatie en een werkomgeving waarin je continu wordt uitgedaagd én ondersteund om te groeien.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Consultant RELEX ben jij verantwoordelijk voor de implementatie van het RELEX-platform bij onze klanten. Je zorgt ervoor dat het systeem volledig wordt afgestemd op de businessbehoeften, van forecasting en replenishment tot space en promotion planning.

Je fungeert als inhoudelijk expert. Je begeleidt klanten gedurende het volledige traject van initiële analyse tot succesvolle livegang en nazorg en weet precies hoe je RELEX op de juiste manier inzet voor maximale impact.

Daarnaast:

  • Vertaal je klantbehoeften naar slimme en schaalbare RELEX-configuratie.

  • Werk je nauw samen met RELEX zelf, klantteams en interne specialisten.

  • Configureer je RELEX F&R or S&A op basis van de to-be processen.

  • Jij bent zelfstandig in je werk en de configuraties zijn volgens

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Bij IG&H helpen we onze klanten om koplopers in hun markt te worden door de business technology expert te zijn waarop ze kunnen vertrouwen in de voortdurend veranderende digitale wereld. We doorbreken silo’s en brengen consultingvaardigheden samen met diepgaande expertise in data, technologie en organisatieverandering om organisaties succesvol te transformeren.

 

Wil jij verantwoordelijkheid dragen voor complexe dataplatformen, technische richting bepalen binnen projecten en klanten helpen bij het vertalen van data-architectuur naar schaalbare oplossingen?

Dan is deze Senior Data Engineer positie iets voor jou.

 

We zijn op zoek naar een Senior Data Engineer om datagedreven producten te ontwerpen, te bouwen en richting te geven aan een schaalbare en toekomstbestendige data backbone voor onze data science- en analytics-projecten. De Senior Data Engineer neemt een leidende rol in het naar een hoger niveau brengen van de data-architectuur, datahandling en data-automatiseringsmogelijkheden van onze klanten. Daarnaast pas je jouw technische leiderschap, ervaring en visie toe om robuuste, efficiënte en herbruikbare data-oplossingen te realiseren en collega’s hierin mee te nemen.

 

Wij zoeken iemand die:

  • De lead neemt in het ontwerpen, bouwen en bewaken van herbruikbare datamodellen en data-architecturen.

  • Complexe datapijplijnen ontwikkelt, waaronder ETL/ELT-processen

  • Data lakes en data warehouses ontwerpt en optimaliseert.

  • Analysemethoden en data science-oplossingen operationaliseert en vertaalt naar productieklare toepassingen.

  • De benodigde cloudinfrastructuur ontwerpt, inricht en beheert, inclusief aandacht voor performance, security en schaalbaarheid.

title: Medior Consultant Data Strategy & Governance
description:
Als Medior Consultant Data Strategy & Governance help je organisaties om data en AI om te zetten in concrete businesswaarde. Je werkt op het snijvlak van strategie, organisatie en technologie en vertaalt ambities naar praktische oplossingen die echt werken. 

Je pakt zelfstandig werkstreams op binnen projecten en schakelt met stakeholders op verschillende niveaus. Tegelijkertijd ontwikkel je je verder richting een senior rol, met steeds meer verantwoordelijkheid in complexe trajecten. 

 

Wat ga je doen? 

  • Ontwikkelen en concretiseren van data- en AI-strategieën  

  • Opzetten en implementeren van data governance (rollen, processen, beleid)  

  • Uitwerken van data operating modellen en organisatie-inrichting  

  • Vertalen van businessvraagstukken naar data use cases en oplossingen  

  • Begeleiden van implementaties, zoals datakwaliteit en AI-toepassingen  

  • Uitvoeren van analyses en voorbereiden van workshops en presentaties  

  • Actief schakelen met stakeholders en bijdragen aan besluitvorming

Dan willen wij graag met je in contact komen!

title: SAP Solution Architect
description:
Als voortrekker van de groeiende SAP‑praktijk bij IG&H speel je een sleutelrol in het verder uitbouwen van deze ambitie. Je zet best practices neer, draagt actief bij aan business development en inspireert collega’s door jouw kennis te delen. Dit is een unieke kans om vanaf de basis mee te bouwen, écht impact te maken en nieuwe business te creëren.

Tijdens digitale transformaties combineren we onze rijke sectorexpertise, met meer dan 40 jaar ervaring, met krachtige SAP‑oplossingen. Daarbij werken we met uiteenlopende disciplines, zoals strategie, procesoptimalisatie, AI‑gedreven inzichten, verandermanagement en digitale experience, alles om organisaties écht vooruit te helpen.

IG&H biedt als middelgrote organisatie het beste van twee werelden, volop impact én wendbaarheid. Met sterke kernwaarden en een cultuur waarin mensen centraal staan, krijg je alle ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen en samen successen te vieren. De Great Place to Work‑erkenning onderstreept onze focus op werkplezier, groei en samenwerking.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Je definieert de end‑to‑end S/4HANA‑architectuur, over applicaties, integraties, datastromen en security, en werkt daarbij nauw samen met de Enterprise Architect om aansluiting te borgen met het bredere IT‑landschap van de klant

  • Je stuurt functionele en technische teams aan, bewaakt de consistentie en schaalbaarheid van het ontwerp en zorgt dat alles aansluit op de strategische doelstellingen, waarbij je belangrijke architectuurkeuzes gedurende het hele traject leidt

  • Je neemt het voortouw in thought leadership door de SAP‑visie voor klanten en de markt vorm te geven, innovatieve oplossingsrichtingen te ontwikkelen en bij te dragen aan best practices en toekomstige proposities van de IG&H SAP‑praktijk

title: Senior Information Security Officer (ISO)
description:
Wil jij zorgorganisaties helpen om informatiebeveiliging structureel en praktisch op orde te brengen? Werk je graag op het snijvlak van IT, processen en dagelijkse praktijk, en vind je het belangrijk dat informatiebeveiliging niet alleen een norm is, maar daadwerkelijk wordt toegepast? Dan is deze rol als Information Security Officer (ISO) iets voor jou.

 

Als ISO ben je verantwoordelijk voor het operationeel bewaken en verbeteren van informatiebeveiliging bij klanten van Beter Healthcare. Je vertaalt risico’s en beveiligingsmaatregelen naar concrete acties en zorgt ervoor dat deze effectief worden toegepast. Je werkt nauw samen met IT, privacy, management en de business om informatiebeveiliging integraal in de dagelijkse praktijk te verankeren.

 

Je beweegt je comfortabel tussen analyse en uitvoering: van risico-inventarisaties en beleid tot het ondersteunen bij audits en het vergroten van bewustwording binnen de organisatie. Je bent een inhoudelijk aanspreekpunt voor informatiebeveiliging en weet overzicht te houden in een dynamische omgeving.

 

Wat jij gaat doen

  • Uitvoeren van risicoanalyses en vertalen van risico’s naar passende beheersmaatregelen;

  • Ondersteunen bij audits en certificeringstrajecten (bijvoorbeeld ISO 27001 en/of NEN-normen);

  • Monitoren van de naleving van informatiebeveiligingsmaatregelen en hierover rapporteren aan de CISO;

  • Vergroten van security awareness binnen de organisatie, onder andere door voorlichting en kennisdeling;

  • Adviseren en ondersteunen van teams bij praktische informatiebeveiligingsvraagstukken.

 

Elke opdracht is anders, dat vraagt om flexibiliteit en nieuwsgierigheid. Je werkt op verschillende locaties

title: Chief Information Security Officer (CISO)
description:
Wil jij zorgorganisaties helpen om informatiebeveiliging en privacy structureel naar een hoger niveau te tillen? Werk je graag op het snijvlak van strategie, governance en uitvoering, in een sector waar vertrouwen en veiligheid essentieel zijn? Dan is deze rol als Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) iets voor jou.

 

Als CISO ondersteun je klanten van Beter Healthcare bij het versterken en professionaliseren van hun informatiebeveiliging en privacystrategie. Je werkt aan zowel strategische als operationele vraagstukken en helpt organisaties bij het inrichten, verbeteren en borgen van hun informatiebeveiligingsbeleid en -processen. Als consultant vervul je tijdelijk de rol van CISO en treed je op als strategisch adviseur voor bestuur en management.

 

Je werkt aan uiteenlopende opdrachten, zoals het opstellen en herzien van informatiebeveiligingsbeleid, het uitvoeren van risicoanalyses, het implementeren van NEN- en ISO-normen en het begeleiden van audits en certificeringstrajecten. Daarbij ben je de verbindende schakel tussen bestuur, management, IT en de zorgpraktijk.

 

Wat jij gaat doen

  • Adviseren van zorgorganisaties over informatiebeveiliging en privacy, met focus op strategie en governance;

  • Tijdelijk invullen van de CISO-rol of optreden als strategisch sparringpartner voor bestuur en directie;

  • Opstellen en verbeteren van informatiebeveiligingsbeleid kaders en -processen;

  • Begeleiden van audits en certificeringstrajecten (o.a. NEN 7510, ISO 27001) vanuit strategisch perspectief;

  • Ondersteunen bij naleving van wet- en regelgeving zoals AVG en NIS2 op strategisch niveau;

  • Vergroten van bewustzijn en commitment op bestuursniveau voor informatiebeveiliging en privacy.

title: Senior Project Manager
description:

Je zorgt voor voorspelbare uitvoering, sterke governance en meetbare bedrijfsresultaten. In nauwe samenwerking met de Customer Lead, die verantwoordelijk is voor klantstrategie en waardecreatie, draag jij de verantwoordelijkheid voor delivery, planning, risicomanagement en operationele excellentie over teams, projecten en platforms heen.

Je stimuleert schaalbare dienstverlening, ondersteunt strategische initiatieven zoals het Cloud Centre of Excellence (CCoE) en benut AI om programmamanagement en uitvoering verder te versterken.

Wanneer uitdagingen ontstaan, neem je initiatief om passende oplossingen te vinden en de voortgang te waarborgen.

Daarnaast weet je verschillende belangen samen te brengen en draagvlak te creëren voor verandering

title: Senior Epic consultant
description:
Wil jij zorgorganisaties helpen om hun digitale processen écht beter te laten werken? Ben jij iemand die complexe uitdagingen overzichtelijk maakt en samen met professionals zoekt naar praktische oplossingen? En werk je graag in een rol waarin je jouw expertise rond het EPD (elektronisch patiëntendossier) inzet om het verschil te maken in de zorg? Dan is deze functie bij Beter Healthcare iets voor jou!

 

Als Epic consultant ondersteun je zorginstellingen onder andere bij de (her)implementatie, optimalisatie en doorontwikkeling van hun EPD, een belangrijke schakel in de digitale infrastructuur van de zorg. Je werkt met diverse klanten, stakeholders en zorgprofessionals en draagt bij aan efficiëntere én betere zorgprocessen.

 

Wat jij gaat doen

In deze rol werk je aan uiteenlopende opdrachten waarin jouw kennis van Epic en zorgprocessen centraal staat. Je bent onder andere bezig met:

  • Het analyseren van klantbehoeften en het identificeren van knelpunten binnen Epic-omgevingen;

  • Het vertalen van functionele wensen naar concrete, werkbare oplossingen;

  • Het (her)implementeren en optimaliseren van Epic-functionaliteiten die aansluiten bij de dagelijkse praktijk;

Maar ook het modelleren van verschillende grondwerk ophogingen dan wel afgravingen. Het modelleren van nieuwe hoogwaterbeschermingswerken (dijken) is ook iets waar jij je heel erg in thuis voelt.

Jij bent vanuit jouw expertise betrokken bij de grootste projecten en tenders binnen Dura Vermeer Landelijke Projecten, maar jij kunt als ontwerper/modelleur ook gevraagd worden voor complexe vraagstukken binnen onze regionale projecten. Waar ga je werken?
KWP 103 heeft 12 cliënten, waarvan 2 logees. Op een reguliere dag zijn er 11 cliënten aanwezig op de groep. De cliënten functioneren op laag- tot middenniveau met gedragsproblematiek en zijn in meer of mindere mate afhankelijk van een duidelijke structuur voor de dagelijkse activiteiten. Ook organiseren we groepsactiviteiten zoals fietsen, wandelen en samen films kijken. Kwadijkerpark 103 bestaat uit een team met een aantal vaste medewerkers die langer op de woongroep werken, met daaromheen zzp’ers en beginnende collega’s. We begeleiden onze cliënten vanuit de onvoorwaardelijke relatie en laten onze cliënten ervaren dat ze mogen zijn wie ze zijn. We zien het als een meerwaarde als je ervaring hebt met onze doelgroep, maar met de juiste motivatie, reflecterend vermogen en passie voor de gehandicaptenzorg ben je

title: Teamleider Instroom & Talentontwikkeling
description:

De organisatie verzelfstandigt, de manier van sturen verandert en binnen Mens & Organisatie worden belangrijke stappen gezet om de HR-dienstverlening na verzelfstandiging weer op te bouwen en verder te professionaliseren. Als Teamleider Instroom & Talentontwikkeling krijg jij daarin een sleutelrol.

Je brengt structuur en samenhang, verbetert en ontwikkelt processen en helpt de verschillende disciplines om steeds meer vanuit één gezamenlijke koers te werken.

Een rol waarin je niet in een gespreid bedje terechtkomt, maar juist veel kunt opbouwen. Je combineert mensgericht leiderschap met inhoudelijke stevigheid en krijgt de ruimte om zichtbaar verschil te maken voor medewerkers én voor de zorg aan cliënten.

title: Senior Regiebegeleider EMB-LVB | Seevancksweg 94B | 28 uur | Oosthuizen
description:
Bij Seevancksweg 94B wacht een diversiteit aan cliënten op jouw enthousiasme en zorgzaamheid! Draag jij binnenkort als regiebegeleider bij aan een gezellige, huiselijke en veilige woonomgeving op deze locatie?


Jouw nieuwe werkplek 

Welkom bij Seevancksweg 94B, een van de drie woningen van de Arendshoeve in het gezellige Oosthuizen. Hier wonen negen unieke cliënten tussen de 40 en 75 jaar, met uiteenlopende zorgvragen. Denk aan autisme, het syndroom van down en het 22q11 syndroom. De zorgvraag is divers en vaak individueel gericht. De begeleiding is zowel verzorgend als ondersteunend, sturend en stimulerend. De niveaus variëren van licht tot ernstig verstandelijk beperkt. Een huiselijke sfeer, rust en een persoonlijke benadering staan centraal.   

Samen creëren jullie een warme en veilige omgeving. Dagbesteding vindt voornamelijk buiten de woning plaats, met een gevarieerd rooster van vroege, late, dag- en slaapdiensten. 


Wat jij brengt

Als Senior regiebegeleider ben je meewerkend voorman, de stabiele factor voor de cliënten en heb je een voorbeeldfunctie in het uitdragen van de visie. Met Gentle Teaching als basis biedt je structuur, rust en duidelijke begeleiding. Je stimuleert zelfredzaamheid, motiveert cliënten en brengt een positieve energie mee.

Verder vind je het leuk om het team te coachen en ben je een vraagbaak voor de locatie.

Je bent verantwoordelijk dat alle taken worden uitgevoerd.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
Leafcloud is a sovereign cloud provider based in the Netherlands. We run real European infrastructure on open standards — OpenStack, Ceph, Kubernetes (Gardener) — for customers who care where their data lives and how their compute is powered. 

We are also unusual in how we run our infrastructure. Our Leaf Sites are distributed compute installations placed inside buildings that need heat: data centres that warm offices, hotels, and apartments instead of sending hot air into the sky. The result is genuinely lower-carbon cloud — not a marketing claim, an architectural choice. 

We’re a small team in a serious moment. We’re rebuilding our second OpenStack core, adding Leaf Sites, launching managed databases, and laying the groundwork for sovereign AI inference. There’s real ownership available to people who want to shape what European cloud looks like. 

About the role 

We’re building Leafcloud’s customer-facing platform layer — managed Kubernetes (Gardener), managed databases (CloudNativePG), and the customer portal that ties it all together. This role is the senior engineering anchor for that work. 

You’ll partner directly with the CTO on technical direction, and pair with a second platform engineer on delivery. There is no Platform Lead above you. The platform layer is your domain to shape, alongside the CTO, with real authority on architectural decisions.

title: Algorithm Architect
description:
About Invisix

Semiconductor manufacturers can't build what they can't measure. Invisix Measuring Systems is a fast-growing scale-up in the high-tech industry, developing next-generation metrology solutions for the semiconductor sector. We work at the intersection of optics, software, and data.
We're a small team, but the depth of knowledge inside Invisix is anything but small. Our culture is professional and fast-paced, with short communication lines and a strong sense of shared purpose. Everyone here is committed, and everyone knows their work directly contributes to something bigger.

The Role

The Algorithm Architect provides technical leadership for the algorithms that turn raw measurement data into accurate, trusted physical parameters. They own the architecture of the data-processing, data-conditioning and model-based reconstruction algorithms used across the measurement pipeline, and act as the technical anchor for the algorithm engineering team's day-to-day work.

description: Why We Exist    The world is moving away from rigid ownership models in favour of more flexible, affordable access. Yet the $1.5 trillion device market has barely moved.    Our mission is to transform how technology is bought, used and reused — creating better outcomes for customers, brands and the planet.       What We've Built    Raylo is the subscription infrastructure that enables leading electronics brands, including PlayStation, HP and Dyson, to move from one-off device sales to recurring subscription programmes that increase conversion, deepen loyalty and capture more lifetime value.    We have over $100M ARR, we’re profitable, growing fast, with over a quarter of a million subscriptions across consumers and small businesses. Customers trust us too, with a 4.5/5 Trustpilot rating from more than 20,000 reviews.    For customers, the experience is simple: subscribe to a device, get support throughout, upgrade when you want, and return it when you’re done. Behind that sits an AI-powered operating system that executes and manages device subscriptions end to end: credit and fraud decisioning, lifecycle operations, and the financing engine that enables brands to run subscription programmes at scale.    Brands can unlock a powerful new growth engine with Raylo across embedded checkout, Raylo.com and the customer app — converting more DTC customers, reaching subscription-first demand, and driving repeat upgrades that compound customer lifetime value.    The impact of our circular model is big. We cut emissions per device by around 50% compared to buy-and-discard. We’re B Corp certified, backed by Macquarie, NatWest and Channel 4 Ventures, and recognised by Tech Nation’s Future Fifty.       How We Work    AI is changing what small, ambitious teams can build. Companies that embrace it will define the next decade.    Raylo is uniquely placed to benefit. We combine proprietary technology and data with the orchestration of physical assets, operating across credit, fraud, pricing, logistics, refurbishment, resale and customer care. With AI improving every cycle, our moat deepens with scale.    At Raylo, AI is woven into how we work every day. We don’t ration access or hedge our bets. Our people use the best models and tools, and we expect them to do things that weren’t possible a year ago. Processes that used to be good enough are being rebuilt. Teams are replacing spreadsheets with bespoke tooling, and anyone can query our data layer in plain English and get a real answer in seconds.    We give every team their own hackathon: a chance to step back, start with a blank sheet, and ask: if we were starting today, how would we do this?    The more we automate, the more human judgement matters. AI gives people back time, and we expect them to spend it on the things no model can replicate: conversations, trust, craft and team judgement.    We hire to a high bar. At Serve Robotics, we’re reimagining how things move in cities. Our personable sidewalk robot is our vision for the future. It’s designed to take deliveries away from congested streets, make deliveries available to more people, and benefit local businesses.

Our client is an established, profitable fintech operating at the intersection of crypto and traditional payments. It runs a consumer on/off-ramp platform and a fast-growing B2B infrastructure business: APIs and white-label solutions that let exchanges, neobanks, PSPs, wallets and other platforms embed regulated crypto and fiat services. This is a senior, hands-on legal role with a single, clear mandate: own the company’s UK regulatory build. You will report directly to the CEO and be the most senior legal voice in the business on UK matters.

The UK’s new cryptoasset regime takes effect in October 2027. From that date, regulated cryptoasset activity in the UK requires FCA authorisation. You will own a first-wave authorisation under this new regime end to end, alongside a UK e-money application. For a regulatory lawyer, this is a career-defining piece of work, and the window to start it is narrow.

The role has no direct reports at hire. You will work closely with the company’s EU legal function. This is a deliberately focused UK mandate, not a group legal role.

title: Case Resolution Engineer
description:
Headquarters:  Canada - Remote
 

 Our team is committed to enhancing physician and patient quality of life through Elation, a SaaS cloud-based clinical platform. Since inception, we've been focused on building a delightful, world-class experience that empowers physicians to deliver phenomenal care to patients. 
 Customer support has been the same job for twenty years: a queue, a ticket, an SLA, a closed case. That's ending, fast. Over the next 6–9 months, AI will take on more of the routine, repetitive cases at Elation. That doesn't shrink the human role — it builds on it. The work becomes product intelligence: shaping how AI handles conversations, holding the customer-trust moments that need real judgment, and turning patterns into priorities Engineering delivers. 
 We're hiring Support Engineers to anchor that shift: people who don't just close tickets, but trace them back to the line of product code causing them, ship the fix that resolves the customer's problem immediately, and partner with senior engineers on the cases complex enough to need them. 
 You might be the recent engineering grad who spent a summer at a busy front desk, in a popular restaurant, or on a support line because you like people as much as you like problems, and who's been quietly automating things nobody asked you to fix since your first CS class. Or, you might be the person who leads team projects, tinkers with the dashboards, automations, or workflows so automatically that colleagues assume you are an engineer even if you aren’t. If that sounds like you, this role turns that problem-solving instinct into your core responsibility. 
 As a Support Engineer, you'll bring empathy and judgment to the cases that need it most, own the quality of AI-driven solutions in your domain, and synthesize patterns that influence Product and Engineering roadmaps. We hire for judgment, taste, and curiosity, not process adherence. The bar isn't how many cases you closed; it's how much you reshaped the conditions under which cases happen. 
  Role and Responsibilities  
 
  Synthesize and share customer insights.  Surface patterns from your cases in weekly and monthly reports, participate in Product and Engineering discussions with what you're learning, and mentor Support Team members on AI workflows, scripting, and SQL queries. 
  Use Good Judgment to Solve Cases.  Own customer escalations with cases that genuinely require seasoned judgment, the ones AI can't safely close. Build and protect customer trust in moments that matter. 
  Build and own AI quality.  Configure AI within Elation's stack (intents, knowledge sources, escalation rules), build lightweight external automations and scripts, and own the quality of AI outputs in your domain.

title: Senior Robotics & Machine Learning Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
As a Senior Robotics & Machine Learning Engineer, you will shape the next generation of autonomous ground systems. You will design and implement core components of our end‑to‑end autonomy stack — from perception and prediction to path planning and vehicle control. Your work enables reliable operation of unmanned ground vehicles (UGVs) in challenging environments, including GNSS‑denied areas, off‑road terrain, and multi‑vehicle convoying.

You will collaborate closely with experts across software, hardware, and mission systems to integrate the right sensors, algorithms, and architectures into robust field‑ready platforms. Your contributions directly support Quantum‑Systems’ mission to set the benchmark for multi‑domain autonomous systems.


What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Develop perception modules (object detection, tracking, pose estimation) for precise autonomous vehicle behavior.

  • Build and integrate the full autonomy stack: perception, prediction, planning, and control for diverse ground platforms.

  • Design multi‑sensor fusion setups (camera, LiDAR, radar) for resilient operation in all environments.

  • Implement high‑performance software pipelines for real‑time sensor processing.

  • Validate autonomy functions using real‑world data and advanced simulation.

  • Collaborate with mission‑control teams (e.g., MOSAIC) and vehicle platform teams to ensure seamless integration.

title: (Senior) Embedded Software Engineer - Reliant
description:
As an Embedded Software Engineer, you are a key member of our Architecture team, developing and implementing the core embedded software that enables our autonomous long-range VTOL platforms to operate safely, reliably, and intelligently in highly demanding operational environments.

In this role, you will be dedicated to our Reliant platform – our next-generation long-range VTOL UAS designed for autonomous ISR missions in GNSS-denied and contested environments. You will contribute to mission-critical software that powers autonomous flight, resilient navigation, payload integration, and edge computing capabilities for defense and security customers worldwide.

Together with our world-class team, you will push the boundaries of autonomous aviation, working closely with System Architecture, Flight Controls, AI, Hardware Development, Integration & Test, and Flight Operations to continuously improve Reliant's performance, reliability, and mission capabilities.



What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Design, implement, maintain, and optimize the Quantum-Systems embedded firmware stack for the Reliant platform

  • Develop safety-critical flight software for autonomous long-range VTOL operations

  • Design, implement, and validate new flight control, navigation, and mission management functionalities

  • Export flight control and navigation algorithms from MATLAB/Simulink and integrate them into the embedded autopilot framework

  • Implement, optimize, and maintain BSPs, peripheral drivers, communication interfaces, and sensor drivers

  • Develop embedded software for redundant and safety-critical avionics architectures

  • Integrate navigation sensors including IMUs, GNSS, magnetometers, air-data sensors, radar

title: Computer Vision & AI Engineer - Interceptor C‑UAS (m/f/d)
description:
About the role:

At Quantum Systems, we are building highly autonomous interceptor systems that must perceive, decide, and act under extreme latency, motion, and environmental constraints.

We are looking for a Computer Vision & AI Engineer to drive the perception stack of our Counter-UAS interceptor platform. You will work on low-latency camera pipelines, small-object detection, object tracking, sensor fusion, visual odometry, precision landing, camera calibration, embedded inference, and data pipelines for training and validation.

This role is suited for someone with a strong academic or practical background in computer vision, AI, robotics, or perception systems. A Master’s degree is expected; a PhD is a strong plus. We are open to ambitious early-career candidates if they bring strong technical depth, practical implementation skills, and the ability to own complex perception problems.

Your Mission

You will develop the vision and AI pipeline that turns raw camera data into actionable perception outputs for autonomous flight. This includes low-latency detection and tracking, motion-aware vision, sensor fusion with inertial data, 3D direction-vector estimation, GPS-denied navigation, and precision landing support.


What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Bring up, optimize, and maintain high-performance camera pipelines, including CSI camera interfaces, raw image access, buffering, synchronization, and latency reduction.

  • Develop detection algorithms for small and difficult-to-see objects in moving and rotating camera images.

  • Combine machine learning and classical computer vision approaches where appropriate.

title: Infrastructure Engineer (ML Systems) - Paris
description:
You’ll own the GPU compute that powers our model training, evaluation and serving systems.

This role sits in our Infrastructure team, which works at the lowest layers of our stack, from Kubernetes down to the GPU hardware. You’ll run the clusters, GPUs and schedulers that our research, product and platform teams depend on, and manage the capacity we buy from our cloud providers.

Bleu Robotics is an AI company developing universal AI software for the deployment of advanced robots , humanoids, mobile manipulators, and industrial arms, in real factories. The convergence of humanoid robotics and modern AI is one of the most significant technical opportunities of the decade, and most of the work today still happens in research settings. To enable a robot to learn a new industrial task from a few demonstrations and operate autonomously, with under one hour between the start of the demonstration and the start of deployment.

As Characterization Lead, you will own performance characterization of Zinal retimer silicon and the Randa Active Electrical Cable (AEC) channel. Your measurements will establish datasheet limits, channel classes and guard-bands for validation, manufacturing and customer specifications. Based primarily in Lausanne, you will work with silicon, signal integrity and validation teams, including channel characterization partners in Taiwan.

· Lead silicon and channel characterization from measurement planning and bench setup through analysis, limit derivation and documented hand-off to validation.

· Characterize TX/RX SerDes performance across process, voltage and temperature: swing, jitter, sensitivity, equalization, adaptation, CDR lock, BER bathtubs and shmoos.

· Own channel measurements to at least 50 GHz, including de-embedding, insertion/return loss, mixed-mo

About the role

Gauss Fusion is aiming to build the first commercial scale fusion power plant based on the stellarator concept and is seeking an experienced mechanical engineer to lead on development of the robotic maintenance approach.
The fusion environment within the reactor is very aggressive, and in-vessel components such as the breeder blanket and divertor will need to be replaced on a regular basis as the materials become damaged by the radiation. Due to the environment inside the device, and in order to maintain a high overall availability, the maintenance must be done robotically using automated systems to extract and replace the components and bring the removed ones to a hot cell for separation, waste treatment, and recycling.
Gauss Fusion is looking for an innovative mechanical design engineer with experience in robotics to lead the work defining and developing the maintenance approach for the Gauss stellarator power plant and its key stellarator systems. While the magnetic configuration will be designed to maximise access to the reactor, the complex geometry poses a challenge to fixations and kinematics, and inventive approaches to the problem are required.


Main responsibilities

Manage the Gauss Fusion maintenance approach to meet the requirements of a commercial scale fusion power plant design:

  • Develop workable approaches to achieving high power plant availability, taking account of engineering and physics requirements across the reactor.
  • Integrate these remote maintenance requirements into plant layout specifications.
  • Define approaches to minimising hot cell inventory through efficient handling of removed components.
  • Lead development of the breeder blanket and divertor segmentation and fixations resulting from these approaches.
  • Lead development of remote maintenance testing and demonstration systems for the reactor.

Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
We help companies get compensation right.

What we get paid at work has a massive impact on our lives, and it’s one of the biggest factors in hiring and retaining talent - and yet so many companies struggle to get it right. They simply have no choice but to rely on poor data and unsophisticated tools for their pay decisions. That’s why we created Ravio.

We help many of the world’s most innovative and ambitious companies build stronger teams and reach their goals through better compensation. Our real-time data platform brings compensation into the modern age, tracking the market across all compensation types from salary to equity and benefits.

Ravio is growing fast, which means you can too. We’ve established ourselves as the European leader in our space serving more than 1,200 clients, and now have our sights set on becoming the global go to place for compensation data and tools for managing compensation.

Joining a startup and scaling it into a global product is one of the most challenging and rewarding experiences a career can offer. If that sounds exciting to you, you’re in the right place.


The role

We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join our engineering team and play a major role in our technical leadership during a significant platform shift.

Ravio is moving from a traditional SaaS posture to a platform built around agents - parent agents fronting our compensation data, specialist agents underneath, durable workflows, an MCP-based tool layer, and an eval harness to maintain consistency. You’ll own architecture and technical design across the stack: the customer-facing web app, the agentic platform, and the shared infrastructure connecting them.

title: Product Engineer - ElevenCreative Enterprise
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

title: VP, Growth
description:
About Nivoda

Nivoda is the operating system for the global jewellery industry. Our B2B marketplace connects jewellery retailers with diamond, gemstone and jewellery suppliers in 70+ countries, and we process $300M+ in annual transactions in a $350B industry that has barely been touched by technology.

We remove the traditional barriers of capital, geography and information asymmetry. An independent jeweller in Ohio can source from a cutter in Mumbai with the same ease, pricing and confidence as one of the world's largest chains. That's the whole point.

Our Mission 🚀

Diamond and gemstone trading has run on inefficiency, opacity and exclusivity for generations. Relationships were gatekept, pricing was hidden, and the size of your business decided the terms you got. We're building the infrastructure that changes that — so any jewellery business, anywhere, regardless of size, can compete on the quality of what they do rather than who they know.

The Marketing Team ⭐️

We're a remote-first, low-hierarchy company where the best idea wins. Marketing at Nivoda is at an inflection point: we have real product-market fit, thousands of businesses transacting, a category we have the opportunity to redefine, and a marketing function that has not yet been built to match the scale of the opportunity.

We're hiring a VP of Growth to build Nivoda's marketing function from the ground up and turn it into a predictable growth engine for a two-sided global marketplace.

title: Senior Enterprise Account Executive
description:
We’re looking for an experienced Senior Enterprise Account Executive to join Aibidia’s London team and play a key role in accelerating our growth across the UK and Europe.

This is a high-impact, new business role for an enterprise seller who knows how to navigate complex organisations, engage senior Finance and Tax leaders, and build momentum across multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

You’ll own opportunities from prospecting through to close, working with CFOs, Heads of Tax, Transfer Pricing leaders and other senior stakeholders at some of the world’s largest multinational organisations. Our connected, end-to-end platform provides organizations the ability to take full control of their business and implement considered tax strategies across the entire group. With over 5,000 legal entities managed on our platform and an average revenue of 7 billion Euros among our clients, we are dedicated to helping the world’s largest enterprises transform their cross-border business management, leading to healthy global business.

What you’ll do

  • Own complex enterprise sales cycles from initial engagement and discovery through to negotiation and close.

We build the intelligence that lets robots sense, reason, and act in the real world, moving beyond the lab and into everyday industrial settings like warehouses and factories. Full-Cycle Recruiting & Ownership

title: Account Manager
description:
Mission

Gorilla is the margin intelligence platform for energy retailers. We help some of the largest energy companies in UK, Europe, the US, and Australia understand where they make and lose money, from portfolio level down to individual customer contracts.

We are entering a phase where protecting and growing our existing customer base matters as much as winning new logos. Our annual renewals represent millions in recurring revenue, and every one of them is an opportunity to deepen the relationship, expand into new modules, and prove the compounding value of our platform.

About the Role

You'll own the full commercial lifecycle of Gorilla's existing customer accounts - renewals, pricing, commercial strategy, and expansion - across a portfolio of Enterprise and Strategic accounts, primarily UK-based, with accounts also across Europe, the United States and Australia. This is a farmer role, not a hunter role: you're not chasing new logos, you're running 6–12 months ahead of every renewal, building the pricing and expansion strategy for each account, and turning retention into growth. There's no fixed playbook here.Every account sits on its own pricing history, so the role calls for real commercial creativity, not just process execution. You'll own a book of roughly £3-4m of annual renewals, measured on renewed ARR and expansion revenue from day one. Today this work sits with the CSM and the exec team on top of everything else.This hire gives our existing customers the dedicated commercial attention they deserve and frees leadership to focus on new business.

  • Create and maintain brand guidelines and design templates.

  • Ensure consistency across all visual communications.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Who are we?

At UpGuard, we are replacing manual security bottlenecks with AI-driven precision. Fresh off a US$75M Series C, we are scaling our infrastructure to process 100 billion risk signals daily. This isn’t just growth; it’s a total reimagining of how the world manages cyber risk.

We build the Cyber Risk Posture Management (CRPM) platform that security teams actually love. By integrating security ratings, threat intel, and agentic AI, we empower organisations to stay ahead of an ever evolving attack surface.

Due to continued growth, the Customer Success team is expanding and we require a Customer Success Manager to join our high performing team to onboard and enable our customers. What will you bring?

  • 2+ years' experience in customer success, project management or account

title: Senior C++ Engineer
description:
FinDev is looking for a Senior C++ Developer to join a team building and evolving a large-scale, real-time electronic trading platform for the global Fixed Income market.

The team develops the application layer of an institutional corporate bond trading platform, supporting a range of trading protocols and workflows.

You’ll work primarily with modern C++ on Linux, building and enhancing server-side components responsible for trading workflows, order and trade lifecycle, business logic, and integrations with other systems across the platform.

Locations

  • Georgia
  • Poland
  • Portugal
  • Cyprus
  • Spain

What you will do

  • Enhance and maintain the core list-management service at the center of our electronic corporate bond trading platform, owning the full lifecycle of trade negotiation and execution across a growing set of trading protocols
  • Build and extend the integration services that bridge our platform to internal and external trading systems
  • Work in C++ on Linux in a microservices architecture built on a shared service framework with schema-driven code generation (FlatBuffers and Protobuf)
  • Contribute during all phases of the project lifecycle
  • Work with business counterparts to provide technical solutions to client needs
  • Work with QA and support teams to address issues that arise during development, testing, and in production

Required

  • 8+ years of commercial C++ development for production services; C++20 preferred, strong C++17 acceptable
  • Strong modern C++ fundamentals, including STL, templates and generic programming, RAII and object lifetimes, design patterns, and core concurrency concepts. Comfort with template-heavy C++ code is important
  • Experience building, debugging, and profiling Linux services in production
  • Ability to select appropriate data structures and algorithms for correct, efficient business logic
  • Experience with microservices or service integrations in distributed systems
  • Working knowledge of relational databases and SQL.

Nice to have

  • Experience with electronic trading, order-management workflows, or fixed-income markets.
  • Background in low-latency or high-throughput systems, network protocols, or pub/sub architectures.
  • Familiarity with Protobuf, FlatBuffers, Redis, or similar infrastructure technologies.
  • Experience with Python, shell scripting, CMake/Conan, or AI-assisted development tools.

Benefits

  • Flexible work setup: remote or a hybrid model.
  • Health insurance coverage for those based in Poland and Cyprus.
  • 50% coverage of health insurance for spouses and children in Poland and Cyprus.
  • 24 days of paid vacation.
  • 10 days of paid sick leave.
  • 50% reimburs

title: Senior Software Engineer, Admin & IAM

The Admin & Identity and Access Management (Admin & IAM) team at Mural defines how users sign in, manage their identities, and access Mural's products, as well as how administrators configure and govern their organizations. We own authentication & authorization, Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), user provisioning (SCIM), session management, and the core permission model that powers roles and access control across companies and workspaces. We also own the enterprise administration experience; the configuration and controls that company and workspace admins use to manage their organizations and users. By providing secure, clear, and intuitive controls for users and administrators, we help organizations adopt Mural quickly and collaborate with confidence.

YOUR MISSION

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Admin & IAM team, you will design and ship these capabilities end-to-end, from identity primitives like the permission model and authentication flows to the admin surfaces enterprise customers use every day. Senior Engineers on Admin & IAM own complex technical initiatives, influence platform and security best practices, and collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Infrastructure to deliver secure experiences that feel simple and intuitive. You will report to an Engineering Manager and work with a small, focused team in a remote-first environment, with the option to work from our Buenos Aires office.

This role involves delivering a tailored value pitch on how the PadSplit model and technology consistently drive superior rental income compared to traditional single-family rentals. The ideal candidate thrives in a remote environment, demonstrates strong communication skills, and wants to have an impact on the affordable housing crisis - one room at a time.

Here’s what you’ll do day-to-day:

  • Prospect and Qualify Leads: Research and identify potential property owners who might be interested in becoming PadSplit Hosts and qualify them based on suitability.
  • Conduct Outreach: Execute outreach strategies, including cold calling, emailing, and networking, to connect with traditional property owners.
  • Host Discovery Calls and Meetings: Engage property owners in initial conversations to understand their needs, goals, and potential barriers to joining PadSplit.
  • Deliver Value Propositions: Clearly articulate the benefits of PadSplit's model, such as increased revenue potential, simplified management, and societal impact.
  • Build and Nurture Relationships: Develop trust-based relationships with property owners, acting as a trusted advisor to address concerns and highlight opportunities.
  • Tailor Solutions: Customize hosting solutions based on the unique circumstances of property owners, including financial modeling, property suitability, and compliance requirements.
  • Close Deals: Guide property owners through the decision-making process, negotiate terms, and finalize agreements for onboarding as PadSplit Hosts.
  • Collaborate with Onboarding Teams: Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth onboarding for new Hosts, providing accurate property details and expectations.
  • Track and Report Metrics: Maintain detailed records in CRM systems, tracking outreach activities, conversion rates, and other key performance indicators.
  • Stay Updated on Market Trends: Monitor the real estate market, competitive landscape, and legislative changes to refine outreach and value propositions effectively.

title: Customer service manager (PP)
description:
ParcelHero is one of the UK's biggest parcel delivery price comparison sites, with over 5 million visitors a year. We're a scaling, technology-focused business with 120 remote staff worldwide - and we're growing fast, expanding internationally into the US and Europe this year.

title: Staff Information Security Engineer - AI First
description:
Rithum™ is the world’s most trusted commerce network, accelerating how brands, suppliers, and retailers work together to deliver seamless e-commerce experiences. We provide an unmatched platform for brands and retailers, enabling them to accelerate growth, optimize operations across channels, scale product offerings and enhance margins.

Today, more than 40,000 companies trust Rithum to grow their business across hundreds of channels, representing over $50 billion in annual GMV. Using our commerce, marketing, and delivery solutions, our customers create optimized consumer shopping journeys from beginning to end.

Overview

Rithum expects employees across all roles to leverage AI and technology to improve efficiency, streamline workflows, and create scalable ways of working.

Rithum is embedding AI into every corner of how it operates — and security is no exception.

As a Staff AI-First Information Security Engineer, you own the intersection of AI adoption and information security: designing guardrails for AI-powered products, building automated security tooling, designing security controls and monitoring for an AI-First workforce, helping every team at Rithum move fast without creating risk they cannot see. This is not a typical security role. You spend as much time building and automating as you do reviewing, turning a repeating control into infrastructure-as-code, a manual review into a workflow, and a vague AI risk into a concrete, enforced guardrails. You work autonomously, balancing research with fast-paced delivery, and collaborating closely with Platform Engineering, IT, Security Champions, and external auditors.

Responsibilities

  • Act as the bridge between architectural intent and operational reality; mediate conflicts between security requirements and feasible implementation, propose compensating controls where gaps exist and help register, track and remediate residual risks.
  • Implement preventive, default-on security controls across cloud and enterprise environments, codified as policy- and infrastructure-as-code so security is enforced by design, including controls that govern how AI tools and models may be used.
  • Implement and enforce identity and access controls to an agreed standard, including access boundaries for AI systems and non-human/agent identities by partnering with Platform Engineering and IT to align tooling and policy to the architecture.
  • Assist in maintaining the InfoSec risk register; track emerging threats and translate them into actionable guidance for engineering teams.
  • Support third-party and vendor risk assessments, with a focus on vendors who process data through AI pipelines.

title: Senior Manager, Investor Relations
description:
Liftoff is a leading AI-powered performance marketing platform for the mobile app economy. Our end-to-end technology stack helps app marketers acquire and retain high-value users, while enabling publishers to maximize revenue across programmatic and direct demand.

Liftoff’s solutions, including Accelerate, Direct, Monetize, Intelligence, and Vungle Exchange, support over 6,600 mobile businesses across 74 countries in sectors such as gaming, social, finance, ecommerce, and entertainment. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA, Liftoff has a diverse, global presence.

About this role/team:

The Investor Relations team is responsible for building and running Liftoff's public-company communications with the investment community. This Senior Manager will report to the Vice President, Investor Relations, and play a central role in scaling the IR function's processes and materials as Liftoff establishes itself as a newly public company.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage end-to-end coordination of the quarterly earnings process, including timelines, checklists, and cross-functional inputs from Finance, Legal, Corporate Communications and other internal partners.
  • Draft and refine earnings materials — press releases, earnings decks, Q&A prep documents, and CEO/CFO scripts — in partnership with the VP, Investor Relations.
  • Build and maintain core IR infrastructure: investor decks, roadshow and conference materials, models, fact sheets, and recurring reporting templates appropriate for a public company.
  • Synthesize sell-side analyst consensus estimates and investor feedback for the management team.
  • Conduct competitive and peer benchmarking analysis against comparable public companies (e.g., AppLovin, Unity, Digital Turbine) to inform earnings narratives and investor messaging.
  • Track shareholder base composition, trading activity, and ownership changes; help build and maintain systems to monitor investor feedback and sentiment.
  • Prepare details briefing materials for senior management ahead of investor meetings and conferences.
  • Manage logistics and briefing materials for non-deal roadshows, investor conferences, and analyst days.
  • Maintain and update IR website content and other investor-facing communications channels.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field, with 8+ years of related experience (or a Master's degree with 6+ years) in investor relations, equity research, FP&A, corporate finance, or a related field.
  • Extensive knowledge of or interest in investor relations and adjacent functions (finance, accounting, corporate communications); able to apply that knowledge to solve complex, ambiguous problems independently.

What is Teachable?

Teachable is the platform for experts and businesses who take education seriously. In a world where anyone can ask AI for information, we're the home for those who educate with purpose, modernity, and humanity. We help experts and businesses scale their impact and operations through courses, coaching, and digital downloads that students actually love. From a finance expert teaching Python for investment analysis to a multilingual coach offering business Spanish for executives, Teachable powers human-led learning that drives student trust, connection, and results. With a sleek, intuitive interface and AI as a time-saving partner, the platform enables transformative education rooted in real-world experience. Teachable experts have lived it—that's why they teach it.Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey?

Part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators, experts, and businesses earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to cement itself as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize student outcomes, business growth, and flexibility. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of real-world learning to shape the future, we want you on our team!

About your team:

Our Marketing team spans brand, content, social, customer marketing, events, and partnerships, all working together to build a world-class brand creators love and to drive awareness, engagement, and growth. We connect with new and existing audiences across every channel and turn strategy into work that people feel, from the story on the page to the room at a live event.

What is the role?

We're looking for a Brand & Events Manager to own how Teachable looks, feels, and shows up in the world, on screen and in the room. This is a hands-on leadership role responsible for our brand identity and guardrails, our events program, our creative output, and the corporate partnerships that grow Teachable's reach and credibility.

You'll be the guardian of the brand, making sure everything we put out is cohesive, high-quality, and unmistakably Teachable, and you'll own the moments where creators experience the brand in person. You'll partner closely with our Content Strategy Lead, who owns content and social, so brand and content move as one system.

title: Corporate Account Executive - West
description:
Webflow is the agentic web marketing platform for modern marketing teams, helping organizations build, manage, and optimize high-performing web experiences that drive predictable growth and strengthen brand trust. Building at Webflow will need grit, because we move fast, without ever sacrificing craft or quality.

As a Corporate Account Executive, you’ll play a key role in scaling our go-to-market motion by owning and closing complex SaaS deals with companies ranging from 300-2,500 employees. You’ll take a proactive, outbound-driven approach to building pipeline, identifying and engaging high-potential accounts, and running the full sales cycle from first touch through close. Success in this role requires strong prospecting skills, disciplined discovery, and the ability to navigate multi-threaded buying groups across both technical and non-technical stakeholders, with a focus on $50k+ ACV opportunities.

You’ll partner closely with Solutions Engineers and cross-functional teams to deliver thoughtful, value-based sales motions tailored to each customer’s needs. As we continue to scale the Corporate segment, you’ll help establish repeatable outbound best practices, influence how we engage this market, and make a meaningful impact on the growth of both the team and the business.

About the role

  • Location: Remote-first (United States; BC, Canada).

    • This role will require an in-person onboarding session in San Francisco, CA
  • Full-time

This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Webflow and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s market location, job related experience, knowledge, qualifications, and skills. ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

You take real responsibility for production: when something is slow, you find out why, whether the answer is a bad query, application code or the infrastructure underneath.
You also help us make AI reliable in production. Document extraction, long-running analysis jobs and agentic features are core to where the product is going, and we need people who make these workflows testable and dependable rather than impressive in a demo.
Our company size of ~40 people ensures that the best idea wins and political discussions are kept aside. And every line of code helps to improve the carbon footprint of real estate properties.

title: Founding Customer Value Manager (m/w/d)
description:
Intro

Die Bauindustrie verliert jährlich 1,6 Billionen USD durch Ineffizienzen. Einer der Hauptgründe: Dieselben Fehler wiederholen sich immer wieder, weil entscheidende Informationen noch immer in Papierdokumenten und unstrukturierten Dateien verborgen sind.

Genau hier setzt alago an. Wir sind ein Team von elf Personen und entwickeln KI-gestütztes Projektmanagement für die Baubranche. Bereits heute vertrauen uns mehr als 15 Kunden. Unsere Vision ist es, Risiken in Bauprojekten frühzeitig sichtbar zu machen – damit Großprojekte nicht mehr Jahrzehnte dauern oder scheitern.

Wir haben letztes Jahr eine Pre-Seed-Finanzierung von über 1 Mio. € von führenden VCs der Baubranche sowie einem der größten Projektentwickler Deutschlands abgeschlossen.

75 % der Infrastruktur, die im Jahr 2050 existieren wird, ist heute noch nicht gebaut. Lasst uns sie von Anfang an richtig bauen.

Tasks

Customer Experience ist bei uns kein Support-Ticket-Job. Du besitzt den kompletten Kundenlebenszyklus nach dem Vertragsabschluss — kommerziell, operativ und im Produkt.

Damit sitzt du an der Stelle im Unternehmen, an der beide Seiten gleichzeitig sichtbar sind: Du weißt, was Kunden wirklich brauchen und wofür sie zahlen — und du weißt, was das Produkt kann und was es kosten würde, es zu können. Genau daraus entstehen die besten Produktentscheidungen und die besten Deals.

Du bist die erste Person in dieser Rolle und baust den Bereich so, wie er in zwei Jahren für dreißig Leute funktionieren muss.

💰 Revenue Ownership

  • Du besitzt einen Kundenstamm mit klarer Umsatzverantwortung: Retention, Expansion, Renewals.

  • Du erkennst, wo ein Kunde mehr Wert ziehen könnte, und machst den Upsell selbst – weite

Avec Solteo, nous voulons donner toutes ses chances à l'électrification des bâtiments en soutenant ceux qui sont en première ligne : les entreprises d’installation.
