title: Founding GTM Lead
description:
Founding GTM Lead

Remanence is pioneering the next era of enterprise AI by building intelligent systems that learn continuously from real-world execution. We transform complex enterprise workflows and business context into dynamic, interactive environments where AI agents can safely learn, adapt, and improve. By combining high-fidelity simulation environments with state-of-the-art training loops, we build specialized models that solve long-horizon, complex tasks with unmatched reliability. We’re building the most talent-dense AI team in Europe to make this happen.

You’ll own how Remanence goes to market: which customers we focus on, how we win them, and how those relationships grow. Working directly with the founders and technical team, you’ll turn customer insight into clear product priorities and build the commercial foundations of the company.

What you’ll work on

  • Own the full sales cycle with enterprises and vertical AI companies, from prospecting and discovery through pilots, contracts and expansion.

  • Lead customer pilots alongside engineers and researchers. Define clear success criteria, demonstrate business value and convert successful pilots into broader deployments.

  • Help shape the product through customer insight. Identify recurring needs, challenge assumptions and help the team prioritize what matters.

  • Navigate enterprise buying processes, coordinating security reviews, procurement and legal discussions with the relevant teams.

  • Build our GTM foundations: positioning, pricing, packaging, pipeline management and a sales playbook that future hires can build on.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
About Pelico

Traditional industrial manufacturing systems were built for predictability. Supply chains no longer are. Today, real-time data is buried in legacy tools that weren't designed for constant disruption. By the time an issue surfaces, it has already snowballed, sending everyone into firefighting mode. Pelico exists to close the gap between production plans and the daily reality on the factory floor.

We've built the manufacturing orchestration platform trusted by the world's most complex industrial operations : companies like Airbus, Boeing, Safran, Eaton, and Cartier. Our AI connects fragmented supply chain, production, and quality data into a single live operational picture — then puts AI agents to work anticipating disruptions, simulating recovery options, and keeping every team aligned before small problems become expensive ones.

Founded in 2019 and backed by General Catalyst, 83North, and Serena, we've raised $72M and are growing fast — 300% year-over-year revenue growth, deployed in 15+ countries, and supporting factories worldwide. We're headquartered in Paris, with offices in Miami, London and Amsterdam, and we're just getting started.

This is a rare chance to join a company that's redefining an industry that hasn't been disrupted in decades — from the inside.

About the Role

In your capacity as a Senior DevOps / Site Reliability Engineer, you will be instrumental in architecting the orchestration layer that drives Pelico across all fronts, spanning our global SaaS infrastructure to the most restricted, air-gapped enterprise environments.

  • Develop and maintain our GPU-accelerated computational imaging engine for phase retrieval

  • Improve reconstruction quality, convergence, and robustness across varied and imperfect datasets

  • Design and implement new reconstruction methods: physics-based differentiable forward models, regularization and constraint schemes for ill-posed problems, and support for new acquisition modes

  • Translate methods from the literature and from our own ideas into tested, performant code

  • Use physical insight into the optical system to decide how to change the algorithm so that results improve

  • Profile and optimize the engine for GPU performance on large datasets

Your profile

  • A PhD, or equivalent research depth from industry, in a physics-heavy or numerically heavy field

  • Several years developing numerical or scientific algorithms, ideally in imaging, inverse problems, or a comparable domain

  • Strong numerical optimization, both gradient-based and iterative methods

  • Je hebt 2 tot 4 jaar ervaring in sales en account management, bijvoorbeeld in een commerciële, klantgerichte rol.

title: Casemanager Verzuim
description:
Bij Crisp hebben we een missie: eten met meer smaak bereikbaar maken voor iedereen. Dat kan alleen als al onze collega's gezond en met plezier aan het werk zijn. Als Casemanager Verzuim zorg jij ervoor dat we grip houden op verzuim. Je begeleidt leidinggevenden en medewerkers bij verzuimvraagstukken, bewaakt de voortgang van dossiers en zorgt ervoor dat we volledig voldoen aan de Wet verbetering poortwachter.

Wat je gaat doen

  • Je bent eigenaar van het verzuimbeleid binnen Crisp. Je ontwikkelt, implementeert en verbetert een helder en effectief verzuim- en re-integratiebeleid voor zowel kantoor als Operations. Daarnaast initieer je preventie- en vitaliteitsprojecten om het verzuim organisatiebreed terug te dringen.

  • Je onderhoudt nauw contact met de bedrijfsarts en arbodienst, plant de consulten en stemt waar nodig af over complexe casussen. Daarnaast bewaak je de kwaliteit van de samenwerking met externe partijen, zoals de arbodienst, arbeidsdeskundigen en het UWV.

  • Je voert laagdrempelige voortgangs- en re-integratiegesprekken met zieke en herstellende collega's. Je denkt mee over pra

title: Product Manager Operations
description:
Zit het in je aard om te ontrafelen hoe een proces nóg efficiënter kan? Als Product Manager Operations ben je de drijvende kracht achter de uitvoering van procesverbeteringen in onze operatie. Je duikt diep in de data, spoort knelpunten op en ondersteunt de Product Manager Operations bij het vertalen en opleveren van concrete oplossingen samen met ons development team.

Wat je gaat doen

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het identificeren, prioriteren en realiseren van aanpassingen aan onze operations tooling. Dit doe je om de groei van Crisp op een slimme en efficiënte manier te faciliteren.

  • Je werkt samen met onze Lead Product Manager Operations, Analytics en de operationele teams om groeikansen en verbeteringen in hun werkprocessen te identificeren.

  • Je gebruikt data uit de operatie om de impact van deze procesverbeteringen in te schatten.

  • Je trekt je veiligheidsschoenen aan om input op de halen op de werkvloer.

  • Samen met de developers bespreek je in welke technische aanpassingen aan onze tooling benodigd zijn om een procesverbetering te realiseren.

  • Tijdens de implementatie van een verbetering zorg jij voor de borging van het proces.

  • Zodra je een verbetering hebt doorgevoerd meet je de effecten. Je gebruikt deze data weer als input om een volgende verbetering te verkennen.

Als ideale kandidaat heb je enige ervaring opgedaan binnen het Product Management vakgebied. Je kunt goed taken prioriteren, en een inhoudelijk sterke sparringpartner voor zowel developers als managers van de verschillende teams. Daarnaast ben je gedreven om snel te leren en ontwikkele

title: Operational Lead
description:
Bij Crisp hebben we een missie: eten met meer smaak bereikbaar maken voor iedereen. Als Operational Lead zorg jij er samen met je team voor dat ons distributiecentrum in Amsterdam die belofte elke dag waarmaakt: duizenden boodschappen, op tijd en in topconditie bij onze klanten.

Wat je gaat doen

  • Je bent eindverantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse operationele gang van zaken op de vloer. De Operationeel Manager stuurt jou iedere dag aan, en zal je ook begeleiden bij je persoonlijke ontwikkeling en je langetermijndoelen. 

  • Je geeft dagelijks operationeel leiding aan onze Team Leads en bent verantwoordelijk voor de operatie in en rondom het volledige warehouse, niet slechts één hal of afdeling.

  • Je zorgt ervoor dat jouw team iedere dag gemotiveerd is en doelstellingen op efficiëntie, kwaliteit en veiligheid haalt.

  • Je werkt nauw samen met de Warehouse Managers om beleid te formuleren en zorgt voor innovatie in de processen. Je garandeert een goede implementatie van nieuwe initiatieven. 

  • Je zorgt met de Personeelsplanner voor een juiste planning op basis van financiële doelstellingen.

  • Je bent de spil van het warehouse. Je initieert onder andere vergaderingen, gesprekken en communicatie met andere afdelingen. En met jouw leidinggevende ervaring coach je collega-leidinggevenden van alle afdelingen.

Samen met het Warehouse Management draag je eindverantwoordelijkheid voor het warehouse. In het belang daarvan vind je het logisch om minimaal twee weekenden in de maand én twee ochtenden of avonden te werken. Met het Warehouse Management zorg je voor de best mogelijke aanwezigheid.

title: Warehouse Employee
description:
At Crisp, we are on a mission: making better-tasting food accessible to everyone, using the power of the shortest farm-to-table supply chain in a way you can be proud of. As a Warehouse Employee, you ensure that the ultra-fresh products from our suppliers are processed in the warehouse, and then pack them up so they can head out to the customer!

What you will be doing

As a Warehouse Employee, you work alongside your colleagues to ensure our customers' products are packed to perfection. You will be active throughout the day, with a varied set of tasks:

  • Scanning and collecting products in the warehouse, ensuring all groceries are neatly packed and chilled before they go out to our customers.

  • Restocking products, accurately sorting orders, and efficiently preparing shipments.

  • Part of our grocery selection is kept cold; you don't mind working regularly in a chilled environment of 3–6°C or in the freezer at -26°C.

About you

  • You are available at least 32 hours per week

  • You work with great attention to detail.

  • You are reliable.

  • You have good communication skills.

  • You enjoy physically active work.

  • You are currently living in (or close to) Amsterdam.

What we offer

  • An hourly wage up to €17.99.

  • A solid pension plan for the future via BPFL.

  • A fixed percentage of your salary to spend freely via Alleo (e.

title: Customer Experience & Communication stage
description:
Bij Crisp maken we de beste kwaliteit eten bereikbaar voor zoveel mogelijk mensen. Dat doen we met een hypermoderne app, een knettervers logistiek netwerk en – cruciaal – een Service Team dat klanten omverblaast met support van het allerhoogste niveau. Om ons team te ondersteunen bij de dagelijkse service-operatie en communicatie, zoeken we versterking.

Wat je gaat doen

Als Stagiair Customer Experience & Communication steek je écht de handen uit de mouwen om onze interne Service processen soepel te laten lopen. Je bent de spin in het web die zorgt dat onze informatie up-to-date blijft: je herschrijft interne pagina's, pakt operationele klussen op en schrijft heldere stukken tekst voor het team. Als de rechterhand van ons managementteam – van de Manager en Team Lead tot de Senior Agent – krijg je een uniek kijkje in de keuken en leer je alle facetten van dit leiderschap kennen.

Tegelijkertijd is er ruimte voor een (stage)onderzoek. We dagen je uit om kritisch mee te denken over hoe we onze interne communicatiestromen nóg slimmer en efficiënter kunnen stroomlijnen. Een mooie mix dus van operationele meters maken en strategisch meedenken! Je bent verantwoordelijk voor onze interne kennisbronnen. Je gebruikt data om de interne operatie, kennisbank en externe communicatie direct strak en up-to-date te houden in de herkenbare Crisp-stijl.

  • Je duikt proactief in de communicatiestromen om knelpunten te spotten. Je analyseert de nieuwste trends op het gebied van klantcontact en vertaalt deze naar strategische voorstellen om onze interne processen en communicatie te optimaliseren.

  • Je ondersteunt de Leads door de wekelijkse en maandelijkse presentaties en data-visualisaties voor de Service Meetings voor te bereiden.

title: Customer Retention stage
description:
Crisp is een van de snelst groeiende scale-ups in Europa. Klantretentie speelt hierbij een belangrijke rol. Daarom zijn we op zoek naar een allround stagiair die ons kan ondersteunen bij het continue activeren van onze klanten. Bij Crisp bevind je je in een uitdagende omgeving met veel kansen om te leren en jezelf te ontwikkelen. Kom jij ons team versterken voor ten minste 5 maanden vanaf februari 2027?

Wat je gaat doen

Als Customer Retention stagiair krijg je een uniek inzicht in de wereld van consumentenpsychologie en de rol van marketing in consumentengedrag. Je ondersteunt de campagne & promotion specialists in ons Retentie-team bij een breed scala aan marketingtools, van promoties en prijzen tot heractivatie- en nieuwsbriefcampagnes. Je neemt volledig deel aan het Retentie-team en werkt nauw samen met onze Campaign- & Promotion Specialists, en onze Head of Retention.

Enkele voorbeelden van wat je gaat doen:

  • End-to-end uitvoering van e-mailcampagnes; van het aanvragen en selecteren van de juiste inhoud tot het instellen en uitvoeren van de technische details en het analyseren van de resultaten.

  • 360-graden-uitvoering van onze promotiecampagnes, inclusief het selecteren van de optimale promotieproducten, het afstemmen met het forecast- en buyerteam, het creëren en verzenden van communicatie via meerdere kanalen, en het analyseren van resultaten.

  • Het opzetten van A/B-testen om de effectiviteit van onze content en promoties te verbeteren.

Dit ben jij 

  • Je zit in je laatste jaar of bent net afgestudeerd aan een HBO-opleiding of universitaire bacheloropleiding.

title: Culinary & Support stage
description:
Ben jij op zoek naar een uitdagende stage in een culinaire wereld? Zoek dan niet verder! Wij zijn vanaf februari 2027 op zoek naar een enthousiaste stagiair die ons Culinary team komt versterken voor 5 dagen in de week. Het Culinary team is zowel verantwoordelijk voor de inkoop, receptontwikkeling en fotografie van de Crisp weekbox (maaltijdbox), als voor de ontwikkeling van losse recepten die te koop zijn in de Crisp-app. Als Culinary & support stagiair draai je volledig mee in ons team en krijg je de kans om je pro-actieve, creatieve en punctuele vaardigheden te laten zien.


Wat je gaat doen

  • Je verwerkt recepten in de wekelijkse maaltijdbox receptenboekjes.

  • Je ondersteunt de administratieve kant van de maaltijbox- en losse recepten. Je zorgt dat de recepten goed in de app komen te staan.

  • Je bent proactief, bijvoorbeeld in het checken van productbeschikbaarheid en het oplossen van beschikbaarheidsproblemen.

  • Je houdt scherp de feedback kanalen in de gaten, waar mogelijk anticipeer je.

  • Je houdt onze recepten en fotografie databases up-to-date.

  • Je neemt deel aan de recepten brainstorms.

  • Mogelijkheid tot meer verantwoordelijkheden, gericht op jouw persoonlijke interesse.

Dit ben jij

Als ideale stagiair voldoe je aan het volgende profiel:

  • Je hebt minimaal HBO-werk- en denkniveau en bent op zoek naar een meewerkstage.

  • Je bent (vanaf februari 2027) 40 uur per week beschikbaar voor een meewerkstage.

  • Je bent

title: Assistent Teamleider Warehouse
description:
Assistent Teamleider Warehouse

Elke dag worden onze boodschappen met veel zorg ingepakt en klaargemaakt voor bezorging. Als Assistent Teamleider in ons warehouse in Amsterdam stuur je een team van verschillende Warehouse Medewerkers aan om ervoor te zorgen dat onze processen tot in de puntjes worden uitgevoerd. Daarbij los je moeiteloos problemen op die op je pad komen.

Wat je gaat doen

Als Assistent Teamleider geef je leiding aan 10-20 medewerkers, coacht hen bij hun dagelijkse werkzaamheden en zorgt dat ze efficiënt en veilig werken. Daarnaast bewaak je de productiviteit van je team. Je weet wie je wanneer een compliment moet geven, maar bent ook niet bang mensen aan te spreken als ze niet doen wat jij van ze verwacht. Jouw verantwoordelijkheden zijn:

  • Je houdt overzicht over de dagelijkse processen.

  • Je koppelt problemen (en bijbehorende oplossingen) moeiteloos door aan de Teamleiders.

  • Je motiveert Warehouse Medewerkers en zorgt dat zij hun werk met plezier en op tijd afkrijgen.

  • Je kijkt kritisch naar de processen en waar deze verbeterd kunnen worden.

Dit ben jij

Onze Assistent Teamleiders houden van aanpakken. Omdat ze veel aan de slag zijn op de vloer zien ze snel wat er heel goed gaat op de vloer, maar ook wat er beter kan. Dit communiceren ze met de desbetreffende medewerkers, of dit nu Orderpickers, Teamleiders, of Operational Leads zijn. Samen stellen ze de juiste prioriteiten, om ervoor te zorgen dat alles vlekkeloos verloopt!

title: Projects & Innovation stage
description:
Als stagiair(e) bij team Projects & Innovation draag je bij aan het behalen van de operationele doelstellingen op het gebied van kwaliteit, veiligheid, werknemerswelzijn, en kosten. Team Project & Innovations zorgt ervoor dat de processen rondom het inpakken en bezorgen van onze producten stap voor stap slimmer, sneller en efficienter verlopen. Een stage biedt je de kans om mee te werken aan verbeterprojecten bij Supply Chain, Warehouse en Last Mile. Je werkt aan grote verbeterprojecten, maar ook aan kleinere initiatieven waarmee we Crisp iedere dag een beetje beter maken. Kom jij ons team per februari 2027 versterken?

Wat je zult doen

Je wordt onderdeel van het Project & Innovations team samen met ervaren projectmanagers uit verschillende disciplines. Je werkt veel samen met het Supply Chain-, Warehouse-, en Last Mile team. Samen met een projectmanager werk je aan een of meerdere projecten binnen een van de bovenstaande disciplines. Je analyseert en maakt een projectplanning, maar vervolgens ga je vooral aan de slag om jouw verbetering door te voeren. Je krijgt hierin alle ruimte én begeleiding om jouw ideeën in de praktijk te brengen.

Dit ben jij

  • Je volgt jij een hbo- of wo-opleiding in de richting van Supply Chain, Operations, Logistiek, (Technische) Bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare commerciële studie?

  • Je zit in je derde of vierde jaar.

  • Je bent beschikbaar voor een periode van minimaal 5 maanden.

  • Je bent pro-actief, nieuwsgierig en analytisch onderlegd.

  • Je hebt, net als wij, een passie voor duurzaam en lekker eten.

  • Je bent minimaal 32 uur per week beschikbaar.

title: Business Control stage
description:
Als Business Control-stagiair bij Crisp ben jij een belangrijk onderdeel van het Finance team en werk je aan uitdagende projecten op het gebied van data analyse en financiële rapportages. We groeien snel, dus de complexiteit van ons bedrijf neemt voortdurend toe. Hierdoor is geen dag bij Crisp hetzelfde. Dit betekent dat je vanaf dag één veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid krijgt. Kom jij vanaf februari 2027 ons team versterken voor minimaal 5 maanden?

Wat je gaat doen

Vanuit het financiële hart van Crisp krijg je goed inzicht in de onderlinge samenhang van de afdelingen en herken je mogelijkheden voor optimalisatie en verbetering. Tijdens jouw stage leer je niet alleen cijfers en inzichten te delen met interne stakeholders, maar ook scherp te zijn en de juiste vragen te stellen. Door onze Business Controllers te ondersteunen, draag je eraan bij dat ons management op koers blijft en indien nodig bijstuurt. Zo help je mee aan onze missie om beter eten voor meer mensen beschikbaar te maken. Tijdens jouw Business Control stage ondersteun je het Finance team met verschillende taken, zoals:

  • KPI's analyseren en rapporteren aan onze Business Controllers.

  • Bijdragen aan de maandelijkse financiële afsluiting door relevante gegevens te verzamelen en rapporten op te stellen.

  • Automatiseren van onze financiële rapportages.

  • Financiële inzichten leveren voor verschillende bedrijfseenheden.

  • Het Business Control team ondersteunen bij het nemen van beslissingen aan de hand van zelf opgestelde business cases.

Dit ben jij

  • Je volgt momenteel een HBO- of WO-opleiding op het gebied van Econome

title: AI Trainers Network - Arabic
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Trainers Network – Arabic based in Germany.

Join a global network of language professionals and culturally aware contributors helping shape the future of artificial intelligence.
In this flexible, remote opportunity, you can contribute to projects that improve the accuracy, relevance, and inclusivity of AI systems.
Depending on your skills and availability, you may work on text, image, or audio annotation, content evaluation, and prompt creation.
Your Arabic language expertise and cultural understanding will help make AI-generated content more natural, reliable, and representative of diverse communities.
Projects vary in scope and duration, offering opportunities to gain experience with emerging AI technologies while working on your own terms.

Before each project begins, you will receive clear information about the tasks, timeline, and compensation so you can decide whether it fits your interests and availability.

As a contributor to the AI Trainers Network, you will support projects designed to improve AI performance, language understanding, and content quality. Depending on the project requirements and your areas of expertise, your responsibilities may include:

  • Evaluating search results, advertisements, and chatbot responses for accuracy, relevance, quality, and usefulness.

  • Creating, testing, and refining prompts to improve the performance of large language models (LLMs).

Als Europas führender Hosting-Anbieter und Pionier für unabhängige Cloud-Lösungen bauen wir eine Infrastruktur der nächsten Generation: von souveränen Cloud-Architekturen und hochperformanten GPU-Clustern bis hin zu integrierten KI-Automatisierungstools.

As a Quantum Design Engineer in our R&D team, you’ll be at the heart of advancing the performance and scalability of superconducting quantum processors. You’ll lead the design of next-generation qubit chips and modular, scalable QPU architecture, working from on-chip subsystem architecture to EM simulations, frequency allocation, crosstalk management, packaging, and interconnect strategies.

You’ll also design and optimise nonreciprocal superconducting circuits, such as isolators and parametric amplifiers that will drive robust, high-fidelity readout chains. These designs will enhance readout signal-to-noise ratio and stability, feeding into our next-gen readout modules and ensuring seamless coupling with the qubit layer.

This role is highly collaborative: you’ll work in a tight feedback loop with experimentalists and device engineers to transform measurement insights into rapid design iterations, pushing performance, coherence, yield, and manufacturability across the full qubit stack.

Product Research relies on what it shows to decide what to fix next, and to confirm the fix worked.

It gets harder from here. FLUX 3 is our first multimodal model, spanning image, video, audio and action, and each new modality needs its own way of being measured.

StellDirVor is an independent consulting, trade and technology company specializing in immersive technologies for healthcare. Benefits

✔ Flexible Teilnahme – du entscheidest selbst, an welchen Studien du teilnimmst

✔ Teilnahme meist bequem online von zuhause aus

title: Senior Network & Security Engineer (w/m/x/d)
description:
Join the ride!

You own the network and security posture of our platform end to end: the cloud
environments our services run in, the connections between vehicles, offices (VPN),
back-office systems (Admin-Tools), and the controls that keep customer and payment
data safe.
Our product runs on the street around the clock. Your work keeps it reachable, keeps the
wrong people out, and makes every change to the network reviewable and reversible.

Your Responsibility

  • Design, build and run our cloud networks: VPCs, routing, DNS, load balancing, private connectivity and zero-trust access for staff and services
  • Own identity and access: single sign-on, multi-factor authentication, roles and least-privilege access across cloud, tools and application systems
  • Harden the platform: firewall and WAF policy, TLS and certificate lifecycle, secrets management, host and container baselines
  • Run vulnerability management from scan to fix, and lead security incident response with clear write-ups
  • Keep all network and security configuration as code, reviewed and deployed through CI
  • Monitor for abuse and outages, and set alerting that wakes people only when it should
  • Support audits and customer security questionnaires with evidence that already exists
  • Effectively deploy and use AI agents

Your Experience

  • 5+ years running production networks and security for an online service, with on-call experience
  • Deep networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, TLS, routing, VPN and firewalls, on a public cloud and on physical office networks
  • Hands-on with one major cloud provider's networking and IAM, and with infrastructure as code such as Terraform or OpenTofu
  • Identity engineering in practice: OIDC and SAML single sign-on, MFA rollout, role design and access reviews
  • Security operations: vulnerability scanning, log analysis, incident hand

title: Senior React Native Engineer - App Owner (w/m/x/d)
description:
Join the ride!

You own our consumer mobile app end to end, from architecture to store release. One
React Native codebase ships to iOS and Android, and you are accountable for its code, its

The app is how our customers experience the product every day. Your work keeps it fast,

  • Own the app's architecture, code quality, performance and stability on iOS and Android

  • Integrate and maintain third-party SDKs for payments, maps, analytics and messaging
  • Build and maintain automated test coverage and run it in CI
  • Keep the codebase's AI tooling in version control and review it like code

  • 5+ years of React Native in production, shipped to both the App Store and Google Play

Highly desired

  • Experience in mobility, logistics or another operations-heavy consumer product
  • Map-heavy apps: location permission

Tasks

title: Salesforce Lead - Agentforce
description:
About Ledger

We’re a team of experts pushing the limits of what’s possible, united by our common goal to unlock true freedom through digital ownership, making technology accessible for all. We believe in a world where users, creators and enterprises manage their value with ownership and freedom. Our curiosity drives us to innovate, empowering individuals on a global scale.

We believe change is constant and our team moves forward as one, with a culture of problem-solving where every employee is empowered and supported to challenge tradition and create solutions. Our mission is simple: to make self-custody accessible and give people the keys to their own financial futures. If you want to make a true impact, we want you to join us at Ledger.

At Ledger, we’re proud to be the global platform for digital assets and Web3, with over 20% of the world’s crypto assets secured through our Ledger devices. With our headquarters in Paris, and offices in Vierzon, Grenoble, Montpellier, London, Portland, Geneva, Zurich and Central Singapore, we have a team of around 600 professionals developing a variety of products and services to enable individuals and companies to securely buy, store, swap, grow and manage crypto assets – including the Ledger hardware wallets line with more than 7.5 million units already sold in 200 countries.

The team:

Join our Customer Success department as a Salesforce & Tooling Lead, where you will own the strategic direction and day-to-day operation of our Salesforce ecosystem – spanning both Enterprise and consumer environments. This is a senior, hands-on leadership role in which you will line-manage a small team of Salesforce Administrators while serving as the primary technical expert for our Agentforce deployment and broader Salesforce architecture.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Infrastructure
description:
Staff Software Engineer, Platform & Infrastructure

The role

We are hiring a Staff Software Engineer for our Infrastructure team.

Stream runs behind apps that more than a billion people use: billions of API requests a month, a 99.999% uptime promise, and a small team keeping it all running. Infrastructure here decides how fast our products feel, how well they scale, and how quickly we can launch new ones.

This year we're wrapping up a big move. We're simplifying where and how we host, and rebuilding our data layer on self-hosted, open-source systems that are faster and cheaper to run. That's the groundwork, not the job. Next comes building the infrastructure every Stream product runs on, including the ones we haven't built yet. That means real SLOs, clear costs, calmer on-call, and a platform that helps teams ship faster.

What you build will shape how much Stream spends and how fast it grows, and we'll trust you with big decisions from your first few weeks.

This is a Software Engineering role first. Attitude, ambition and a willingness to experiment across the stack matter more to us than years of Kubernetes or database operations. We expect AI to cover a good share of the DevOps-heavy work, and we expect you to use it that way. What a tool can't give us is system design judgement, strong fundamentals and good code, so that is what we look for.

Platform & Infrastructure is a small, senior team without the support structures of a large organisation. It moves fast and it gets hectic. We would rather say that now than have you find out in month two.

title: Battery Engineer / Technician, Electrode Specialist
description:
Who we are

At CarbonX, we are solving one of the clean energy transition's biggest bottlenecks: replacing imported graphite in EV batteries with a local, scalable, high-performance carbon material. Our technology enables 6-minute ultra-fast charging and lower production emissions, dropping directly into existing commercial manufacturing lines without requiring cell makers to retool.

Born out of TU Delft, we’ve crossed the initial R&D threshold. We are now transitioning from technology development to industrial manufacturing and global scale—expanding our footprint across the Netherlands, Texas, China, and South Korea to supply Tier-1 automotive and battery partners.

If you're motivated by high-velocity execution, true hands-on ownership, and doing work that has a visible, measurable impact on global energy independence, this is where you can build something that scales.

The Role

As our Electrode Specialist, you will take direct responsibility for our electrode-making process in our Delft laboratory. This is a practical, bench-first role (80% practical lab execution & quality control, 20% data analysis, reporting & process improvement) that sits at the center of our commercial validation pipeline.

Because CarbonX materials physically behave differently from standard graphite during dispersion and calendering, you will play a crucial role in diagnosing processability, optimising slurry formulations, and ensuring defect-free electrode production.

Our digital programmes help people manage weight-related illnesses by focusing on what matters most: improving health, building confidence, and enhancing quality of life.

Join us, and be part of the team making that future possible!

This position directly advances our mission of making personalised, clinical care accessible to everyone by building a robust, repeatable pipeline of new patient leads.

Evervault is hiring its first Security Engineer in London.

We build modular card payment infrastructure for companies building payment products or their own payments stack. Our tools help developers keep raw card data off their systems, reduce PCI compliance work, and improve payment acceptance, fees and fraud outcomes. Our customers include Rippling, Ramp and Sorare.

We’re a Series B company backed by Index Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Kleiner Perkins.

You’ll join our platform group and own application security from day one, with scope to take responsibility for security across Evervault over time. You’ll be our first dedicated security engineer, working closely with the engineers who build and run our products.

In your first year, expect roughly half your time to go towards hands-on security engineering and half towards audits, questionnaires and customer security reviews. Both are core to the job. You’ll help make our systems more secure and give customers confidence in how we protect their data.

Your work will include:

  • Finding and fixing vulnerabilities in our applications and infrastructure.

  • Building security checks and tooling into how we develop and ship software.

  • Working with engineers on security decisions in product and system design.

  • Owning security and compliance audits, including evidence collection and resolving findings.

  • Handling customer security reviews and questionnaires, and explaining our controls clearly.

title: Business Development Representative
description:
About Evervault Evervault provides online card payment infrastructure primarily to companies building card payments into their products, as well as to sophisticated merchants who manage payment routing in-house. Best-in-class companies like Ramp, Overwolf, and Modern Treasury build their products on top of Evervault.

title: Product Designer
description:
We're unlocking access to the NHS, because healthcare is not truly free until it's truly accessible 💙

The world’s best healthcare, for free. It's not a new idea, it's called the NHS. But the largest healthcare provider is fundamentally broken. Patient satisfaction is at an all time low, and the biggest reason cited is lack of access. So we’re on a mission to fix it with technology that actually works.

We're building the front door of UK healthcare, creating a future where one billion NHS appointments are transparent and instantly bookable, and patients are guided to the right service first time using AI.

We're developing critical national infrastructure. Today, 26% of GP practices in England use our patient registration software, while one in five GP practices in London use Bookable Search to help new patients find and book appointments seamlessly.

Our latest product, Bookable Navigator, extends this vision by automatically booking appointments for existing patients.

We operate from within a working GP practice in East London 🏥 We're backed by Y Combinator, Innovate UK and the NHS Clinical Entrepreneur Programme, and were previously ranked the 8th fastest-growing startup in the UK and 33rd fastest-growing in Europe 🚀

title: Senior Applied AI Engineer – Agent Runtime (Alwin by DataSnipper)
description:
We are looking for a Senior Applied AI Engineer to join the Agent Runtime team behind Alwin, our new Agentic Automation Platform for audit and finance. Alwin agents run for long times, work through multi-step audit procedures over client evidence, and return finished work papers with every number traced back to source. Humans review and sign off.

The runtime is the layer every agent depends on: the model access, the base system prompt and context, the tools (document extraction, retrieval, sandboxes, MCP integrations), the orchestration of agents and sub-agents, and the observability and evals that tell us whether an agent is performing to objective standards. You will own the applied AI half of that layer. Product teams build audit-specific agents on top of it; you decide how the base agent reasons, what tools it gets and at what abstraction, how it manages context over long horizons, and how we measure and hill-climb accuracy, speed and cost.

This is a hands-on role in a small team with a large blast radius. Your work goes in front of hundreds of thousands of audit and finance professionals, and the problems are largely open: there is no playbook for production agents in a regulated domain, so you will help write it.

About DataSnipper

DataSnipper is the Agentic Automation Platform for audit and finance. Known worldwide for our Excel add-in, we are now building Alwin by DataSnipper: purpose-built agents that execute audit and finance workflows end-to-end, with every output traceable back to source evidence and a human signing off. Headquartered in Amsterdam with offices in New York, Tokyo, Kuala Lumpur and Sydney, we are used by hundreds of thousands of professionals at the world's largest firms. Our mission: automate the mundane, unlock the meaningful.

description:

Proteins are the molecular machines of life, used for many therapeutic, diagnostic, chemical, agricultural and food applications. Designing and optimizing proteins takes a lot of expert knowledge and manual effort, through the use of custom computational and biological tools.

title: Performance Marketer (Paid Ads + Creative)
description:
Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era. Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it. We're the team they call.

Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. Our open-source engine, Soda Core, is used by companies like Tesla, Slack, Adyen, Walmart, and JPMC. The category is growing fast because AI doesn't work on bad data.

We're hiring one person to own paid acquisition end to end.

About Us

Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making.

The Role

Not to manage an agency. Not to approve creative someone else made. You write the ad, you make the asset, you build the landing page, you launch it, you own the budget, and you read the numbers on Monday and kill what didn't work.

You'll join the Growth team reporting to a co-founder.

What you might call yourself. Performance marketer, paid media manager, paid acquisition lead, demand gen manager, growth marketer, creative strategist, media buyer, or the person at a startup who just ended up running the ads. We don't care what's on your CV. You need to have run B2B paid yourself and you need to have made the creative, and most people have only done one.

Who this is for. People who have personally run enterprise B2B ads at a company nobody had heard of yet. You know what a $40 click feels like, you know why the creative that won on LinkedIn dies on Reddit, and you have opinions about it that you earned by losing money that mattered.

If your last job was allocating budget across channels and reviewing what an agency shipped, this isn't it. If you've been making the ads yourself because it was faster than briefing someone, this is it.

What You'll Do

  • Own paid acquisition end to end: LinkedIn, Meta, Google, Reddi

 Location: Remote, non-US based, working US Central Time business hours
Experience: 1-3 years in a B2B SDR/BDR role
Employment type: Full-time
Reports to: Product Manager - Growth 
 ABOUT KYRO AI
When a major storm knocks out power, utilities race to mobilize crews and get the lights back on. Kyro AI builds the software behind that effort: workforce and contractor management for electric utilities, storm restoration contractors, and aggregators. We are headquartered in Plano, Texas, and were spun off from Think Power Solutions, so we pair long-standing utility expertise with the pace and ownership of a product company.

 https://kyro.ai/  
 WHY JOIN KYRO
- Work that matters: our platform helps communities get power back after storms and keeps a critical, regulated industry compliant.
- A growing product suite: StormShield for storm restoration, Kyro Capital for contractor invoice factoring, KORY (our AI copilot), and contractor onboarding and verification.
- Credibility from day one: you sell with the backing of real utility relationships and domain know-how.
- Close to leadership: direct access to the CEO and product team, and what you hear from customers shapes the roadmap.
- Room to grow: a clear path from SDR to Account Executive.
- Flexibility: fully remote team. 
 THE ROLE
As an SDR, you are the first conversation most utilities and contractors have with Kyro. You will work two segments with very different buying motions: 
 Utilities (enterprise): You will talk to storm response, emergency management, contractor management, supply chain, and procurement leaders. Cycles are long, involve multiple stakeholders, and are often tied to RFIs/RFPs. A win is a qualified discovery meeting or demo handed to the account team. 
 Contractors (SMB to mid-market): You will talk to owners, operations managers, and storm coordinators at line, vegetation, and restoration contractors. Cycles are shorter, phone-first, and owner-led. A win is a demo held and the contractor signed up and onboarded. 
 WHAT YOU'LL DO
- Prospect outbound: research target utilities and contractors, build account lists, and reach decision-makers by phone, email, and LinkedIn.
- Own the follow-up: run multi-touch cadences, chase no-shows and stalled conversations, and make sure every lead has a dated next step.
- Respond to inbound leads the same business day and qualify them before they go cold.
- Qualify with rigor: confirm need, timeline, decision process, budget, and compliance requirements before booking.
- Book and confirm demos, send reminders, and hand off with clear notes.
- Drive conversions: stay with contractors after the demo until they sign up and start onboarding; keep utility opportunities moving to the next stage.
- Keep the CRM clean: log every activity, stage change, and next step.
- Feed the product team: share objections, competitor mentions, and feature requests

For more than 45 years it has been a single source for fabrics, trimmings, linings and decorative drapery hardware for the interior design trade across North America, offering high-quality products at a range of price points for residential, hospitality and contract projects.  With distribution centres in Toronto and Buffalo, New York, an extensive showroom network and a knowledgeable sales team, Alendel works by a simple promise: Service · Quality · In Stock. It has been recognized for Canadian Business Excellence in consecutive years and as a Great Employer during Canada's Healthy Workplace Month. The business is growing, and its culture is rooted in integrity, accountability and long-term partnerships with customers and team members.      THE OPPORTUNITY   Alendel is looking for an experienced manager to lead its Customer Service function and strengthen the end-to-end customer experience across Canada and the United States. This is a newly created operational leadership and transformation role. Day-to-day service and order support matter, but the bigger mandate is to build a scalable, measurable, technology-enabled North American customer experience model.  You will lead through people, processes, data and systems rather than absorbing transactional work yourself. Reporting to the COO and partnering with Sales, Operations, Warehouse, Finance, Credit, Product and IT, you will set clear standards, create visibility into workload and performance, develop your team, and make sure improvements are implemented, adopted and measured. Set measurable service standards — including 95%+ compliance with a four-business-hour response standard — and ensure escalations have clear ownership and follow-through.    People Leadership & Accountability    Lead, coach and develop a team of approximately eight, with regular one-on-ones, performance reviews and capability building.  Delegate transactional work so your time stays focused on management, analysis and improvement; build cross-training and backup coverage.    Operational Planning & Execution    Build and drive a Customer Experience improvement roadmap with clear priorities, owners, timelines and measures of success.  Run a regular operating cadence on KPIs, service performance and open issues, solving root causes before they need senior-level intervention.    Capacity, Analytics & Reporting    Create reliable workload and capacity visibility across email, phone, order processing and other activities. title: Teamleider Klantenservice

Bij Vattenfall bouwen we dagelijks aan een sterke klantenservice, met één duidelijke ambitie: het meest klantvriendelijke energiebedrijf van Nederland zijn. Krijg jij energie van een dynamische omgeving, verschillende rollen en het ontwikkelen van mensen? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.   Wat ga je doen?   Als Teamleider Klantenservice geef je leiding aan een team van ongeveer 18 Energieadviseurs. Je bent zichtbaar, benaderbaar en betrokken – zowel op de werkvloer als op afstand. Je combineert coaching en resultaatgerichtheid met een sterke focus op klantbeleving. Daarnaast Zorg Je Ervoor Dat Klantcontacten Waarde Toevoegen Door Duurzame Keuzes Te Stimuleren, Commerciële Kansen Te Benutten En Slim Te Werken In Een Wereld Van AI, Met Als Doel Operational Excellence Te Realiseren. Je kent hun drijfveren, weet wat er speelt en stimuleert groei door heldere feedback en een open houding.  Als manager stuur je actief op resultaten zoals kwaliteit, NPS/KTO, sales en efficiency. Wanneer nodig spring je bij en geef je het goede voorbeeld: de klant staat altijd centraal. title: Account Manager

As an Account Manager, you will retain and expand revenue with the existing customer base through renewal and upsell motions. You will also play an integral part in defining and building our account management team for their fast-growing start-up.      You Will:       Own and manage contract renewals, upsells, and expansion opportunities within your customer portfolio. Skilled in delivering engaging, web-based product demonstrations to global audiences.  Ability to interpret and use data to drive customer outcomes and internal decision-making.  Excellent written and verbal communication skills.  Adoption of Ai into daily practices beyond using it to improve writing or research: Building Gems, Projects, SlackBot etc.  A strong sense of curiosity and commitment to ongoing learning and growth.  Highly coachable and receptive to constructive feedback.  Previous experience in a startup environment is a plus.  Proficiency with CRM tools, especially Salesforce.

title: Customer Success Manager
description: We are Bambuser, and we’re reshaping commerce      Video has quickly become one of the most powerful ways for brands to engage, inspire and convert consumers.  At Bambuser, we’re helping some of the world’s most recognized brands transform how they sell online through live shopping, shoppable video and interactive commerce experiences. Brands including LVMH, Audi, Sephora, Decathlon and Sonos use our platform to create richer, more engaging customer experiences and measurable commercial impact.     Now, we’re rethinking how we help a broader portfolio of customers realise that value at scale.     That’s where you come in. ✨     ________________________________________________________________      ABOUT THE ROLE      As our Customer Success Manager for Scaled Accounts, you’ll own a broad portfolio of approximately 45-50 customers, with direct responsibility for their adoption, value realisation, retention, renewal and growth.     This is not a traditional high-touch CSM role built around recurring meetings with every customer. You’ll use customer health, product usage, engagement and commercial data to determine where your attention can have the greatest impact. You’ll combine automated and one-to-many engagement with targeted 1:1 support when there is a clear risk, renewal, adoption need or growth opportunity.     You’ll still fully own the customer relationship and its commercial outcomes. The difference lies in how you deliver Customer Success: intelligently, proactively and at scale.  You’ll also help us shape what scaled Customer Success should look like at Bambuser. Working with the wider CS team, you’ll develop smarter programmes, triggers, workflows and ways of working that allow us to reach more customers while maintaining a relevant and valuable experience.     If you’re excited by the combination of customer relationships, commercial ownership, data and building better ways of working, this is a rare opportunity to make your mark.  ________________________________________________________________      ABOUT THE TEAM      You’ll join Bambuser’s global Customer Success team and report to our Vice President of Customer Success.     You’ll work closely with Implementation, Support, Sales, Product and Engineering to help customers succeed throughout their journey with Bambuser. title: Embedded Control Engineer
description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.


BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Architect a breakthrough energy technology – Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy.

  • Move fast and build what matters – Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engineering,

title: Senior Radiochemist
description:
ABOUT US

Transmutex is a Swiss company founded in 2019. Transmutex is currently advancing the HI-BEAM (High Intensity Breakthrough Engineering for Advanced Medicine) project, an ambitious programme to develop an industrial-scale facility for the reliable production of medical-grade Actinium-225 (Ac-225), a critical radionuclide for emerging targeted alpha therapies. 

Our team spans nuclear physics, engineering, software, radiochemistry, pharmaceutical and industrial development. Working with research labs and industrial partners worldwide, we are building the production capacity needed for the next generation of cancer treatments.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As the HI-BEAM project progresses from conceptual design into experimental validation, Transmutex is expanding its radiochemistry capability to translate established laboratory methods—supported by collaboration with leading international research institutes—into automated, reproducible, and commercially viable production processes.

We are seeking a Senior radiochemist to actively contribute to the technical design of Transmutex’ s radiochemistry process, in strong collaboration with renowned research labs. You will report to the Head of Extraction unit and be part of a small international team

You will primarily be based in Vernier, GE, with regular travel to Villigen, AG and to partner research labs in North America.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

Process development:

  • Design and optimize radiochemical separation and purification.
  • Collaborate across teams to develop radiochemical processes and methodology.
  • Perform radiochemical and chemical analyses, including alpha and gamma spectrometry.
  • Track radiochemistry developments and adopt relevant innovations and best practices.

title: Senior Backend Developer (Python, Java)
description:
Legal AI is only as good as the knowledge behind it. At Lefebvre Sdu, we've been building that knowledge for over 200 years. Day in, day out. Law by law. Word by word. As the Dutch heart of Lefebvre Group, the European leader in legal and tax knowledge, we're also developing our own platform: GenIA-L, where lawyers and tax advisors don't just get an answer, but an answer they're willing to attach their name to. More than 75,000 professionals use it daily, generating over 100 million euros in ARR across Europe. We're looking for a Senior Backend Developer to help build that.

HOW YOU'LL MOVE US FORWARD

Our Knowledge Team is the layer between the content and the AI. We pull in millions of documents from internal databases, public sources, and the web, standardize them, and make them usable for the AI agents that distill answers from them. The real challenge isn't storage but selection. Out of those millions of documents, exactly one paragraph needs to surface the moment a lawyer asks a question. Surface the wrong one, and the agent gives an answer that sounds plausible but is wrong. In our field, that's not a bug: it's a liability issue. What you build determines whether the answer holds up.

There's work to be done, and it's the kind of work you could talk about for a whole evening. The pipeline has been running for six years, built in Scala and Java, and parts of it deserve a new foundation. Reranking is the biggest need: determining which passage, out of a mountain of legal documents, actually answers the question being asked. Not just which one contains the matching words. That's the problem we’re solving. The team is strong on the scientific side, in retrieval, and in understanding what a model can and can't handle. title: Agentic Platform Engineer
description:

Dan zijn we op zoek naar jou!

Jouw bijdrage aan het avontuur

We staan aan de vooravond van een enorme technologische versnelling en zetten vol in op onze 'agentic bet'. Als Senior Agentic Platform Engineer bouw jij de cruciale infrastructuur (het substraat) waarop onze Senior AI Engineers en Data Scientists hun productie-agents bouwen. Dit is geen code-generatieprobleem dat we aan AI kunnen overlaten; het is een hoogwaardig architecturaal vraagstuk. Jij bepaalt wat 'goed' betekent voor een agent in productie.

Wat betekent dit precies?

  • Eigenaarschap van de core AI-infra: In deze rol ben je de eigenaar van de evaluation harness, agent tracing, de prompt- en tool-registry (waaronder het MCP-protocol) en de routing layer voor model calls.

  • Transformatie naar SaaS: Daarnaast transformeer je onze DevOps-omgeving naar een modern SaaS-landschap waarin agent observability, model gateways en agent-aware deploy patterns de standaard zijn.

  • Modernisering & DevOps: Naast deze innovatieve AI-infrastructuur neem je de lead in het moderniseren en onderhouden van onze huidige pipelines en core DevOps-taken.

  • Tech-lead rol: Je bent een echte tech-lead van de executie en communicatie: je stemt soepel af met de andere senior developers en zet complexe uitdagingen om in heldere sprints.

De opkomst van AI-coding tools verandert de softwarewereld in sneltreinvaart: code schrijven wordt goedkoper en sneller, waardoor de hoeveelheid code die we produceren enorm groeit. Maar meer code betekent ook een groter testoppervlak. Om te voorkomen dat onze ontwikkelsnelheid stokt bij de vraag "kunnen we dit wel met vertrouwen naar productie brengen?", hebben we jou nodig. About Linro

Linro is a Berlin-based cloud security company building a real-time, agentic cloud-security platform. Teams ship with AI. AI ships with Linro.

Infrastructure changes constantly, and increasingly it's AI agents making the changes. Tools that scan snapshots and flag risk after the fact can't keep up. Linro enforces intended state across the whole lifecycle instead, from commit to runtime: MCP and pre-commit hooks at commit time, blast-radius simulation that blocks bad changes before they ship, and real-time detection, enforcement and auto-remediation in production. Most tools tell you what's wrong. Linro stops it.

We have each been on the receiving end of this problem: Running cloud security at scale, building the platforms underneath it, and shipping in regulated systems where a wrong change isn't an option. Founded in Berlin in 2026 and built fully remote across Europe, Linro has a platform that's real and working, with plenty still to shape.

The role

You would be the engineer who gets Linro running inside a customer's real environment and keeps it running. Our founders and go-to-market team win the customer and own the commercial relationship. You own the technical side: you take a customer from signed agreement to a working install and the first blocked change, and stay on it after go-live for upgrades, incidents and tuning. Part of this happens on-site: you may spend a few days at a customer's office to get an install running or to work through a problem with their team. Everything you learn goes back to engineering and product. This is an engineering role, not a support or sales role, and there is no quota.

What you will do

title: Senior Quantum Fault-Tolerance Architect (f/m/d)
description:
eleQtron develops and operates full-stack quantum computers based on trapped-ion technology. Our approach combines laser schemes for cooling/initialization/readout, engineered magnetic-field gradient induced coupling (MAGIC) combined with microwave control for universal gate sets, and advanced quantum control techniques and dedicated firmware to work within the high-fidelity regime and below the error threshold of quantum error correction (QEC).


A central objective of our technology roadmap is the realization of fault-tolerant quantum computing. To achieve this goal, we combine the above high-fidelity quantum hardware with microscopic physics-based modelling, hardware–software co-design, advanced characterization and benchmarking techniques, and detailed numerical simulations to model system performance realistically and identify the optimal QEC strategy and the associated system requirements.

As part of our initiative towards fault-tolerant quantum computing, we are expanding our Foundations & Concepts team and are looking for a Senior Quantum Fault-Tolerance Architect (f/m/d) to help establish and grow this strategic activity within the company.


Role Overview:

As Senior Quantum Fault-Tolerance Architect (f/m/d), you will help shaping eleQtron’s long-term roadmap towards logical quantum computing, driving research activities in quantum error correction and fault tolerance, contributing to key architectural decisions, coordinating cross-functional efforts across hardware, software, system architecture and applications, and playing a leading role in building and growing the company’s fault-tolerance capability.


Responsibilities: 

  • Develop and drive fault-tolerant quantum-computing strategies and logical architectures for trapped-ion MAGIC quantum processors.

title: Co-Founder & CTO @ AI Model Efficiency Engine Venture, Berlin
description:
This is an Atlantic portfolio venture.

About the Venture

AI models have moved faster than most companies’ ability to put them to work. The capabilities are there; knowing how to combine them effectively is still catching up.

Frontier labs naturally put their own models first. Companies often follow suit, asking one general-purpose model to handle ten very different jobs. We believe there is far more to unlock in the models that already exist, even before the next generation arrives. That is the opportunity we are building around.

We bring closed providers and open-weight models together behind a single API. With no proprietary model to promote, we can choose the right combination for the task. Our engine breaks requests into their component parts, routes each to the right model within a cost budget, fine-tunes on customer data and checks the result against agreed quality standards. Think ten specialists working on ten pieces, rather than one generalist carrying the whole task.

Lower costs matter because of what they make possible: giving a small team the freedom to build something that would previously have required a much larger one.

Our founder was selected for Slush 20 Under 20, awarded by Anthropic, Slush, Index Ventures and Sifted, and brings considerable drive, a hands-on approach and a strong sense of urgency to building the company. We closed our pre-seed round in two weeks. With people already waiting to use the product, we are looking for a technical co-founder to help shape what comes next and bring it into production.

title: Growth Product Manager
description:
The essentials

Team: Product & Engineering

Start date: As soon as possible

Location: Berlin — hybrid, 3 days in the office

Working language: English (German: a plus)

Salary band: Shared before your first interview

Your impact

As Growth Product Manager at 7NXT Health Group, you drive subscriber growth across all our brands. You find the problems behind our key metrics, test your way to solutions, and make sure what we learn in one brand helps the others. Your focus spans the subscriber lifecycle — with the emphasis on its two ends: acquisition and retention.

You work in close collaboration with Marketing to bring the right people in and find the right offers to keep them: a lot of testing on pricing, offers, landing pages and cancellation flows. This is a mid-level role with real ownership in a fast-moving environment.

What you’ll drive

  • You own the experimentation roadmap, from metric to hypothesis to shipped test and clear result

  • You partner closely with Marketing and CRM on funnels, landing pages and campaigns, and own the testing of pricing and offers

  • You share what works across the group, so a win in one brand becomes a test in another

What defines you

Must-have

  • Experimentation and growth mindset. You turn a metric into customer problems and sharp hypotheses, run sound A/B tests, and build a roadmap around what will move the number.

  • Data and customer insight. You do your own analysis, from funnels to test read-outs, and combine it with research and interviews to find the real problem.

  • Hands-on attitude, comfortable using AI. You build and launch things yourself — landing pages, tests and prototypes — and use AI to automate your workflows.

  • Ownership. You own outcomes end to end and step in beyond your scope when the team needs it.

title: Founding Account Executive, New Business
description:
About Fyxer

Fyxer launched in May 2024 and hit $1M in revenue across 3,000 paid users without spending a dollar on marketing. We've since gone from $1M to $30M ARR and raised a Series B led by Madrona, with Lakestar, 20VC and Marc Benioff behind us.

Far more people start using Fyxer every month than we can speak to. Nobody owns turning those users into paying teams. That's the biggest surface in the company, and it's this seat.

The role

You work accounts where someone is already using the product. One person trying Fyxer is often a door into a 500-person company. Spot those fast, get to the people who sign, prove out the pattern so it repeats.

You run the full cycle. First touch, discovery, demo, pricing, close. No handoffs.

You also write the first version of everything: the pitch, the sequences, the objection handling, the qualification bar. None of it exists yet. What you prove out is what the next reps get trained on.


What we're looking for

  • High performer, president club pedigree seller who can name 30+ deals you closed yourself in the last 12 months

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with stakeholders at all levels of an organization

  • You've worked without a playbook, or built one where none existed

Three years in or twelve. We care what you've done, not where you did it.

How we work

Time with customers is the only thing that compounds. E

As existing customers take on new integrations or complex initiatives, you might again lead the planning and delivery.

title: Research Scientist - Robot Learning (VLA / WAM)
description:
SpAItial is pioneering the next generation of World Models, pushing the boundaries of generative AI, computer vision, and the simulation of reality. We are moving beyond 2D pixels to build models that natively understand the physics and geometry of our world. Our mission is to redefine how industries, from robotics and AR/VR to gaming and cinema, generate and interact with physically-grounded 3D environments.

We're seeking a Research Scientist to train the policies that turn a world model into a robot that acts. You will own vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action models (WAM) end to end, starting, including data, backbone, action representation, training runs, and the evaluation that tells us whether a policy is genuinely competent or merely lucky. A world model that understands geometry and physics still doesn't act on its own; the policy is what closes that gap. This is a senior, hands-on research role for someone who has already trained manipulation policies that worked, and who can say precisely why the ones that didn't failed.

Responsibilities

  • Own the training pipeline for vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action models (WAM) end to end, from data to a policy running on a robot.

  • Contribute to setting the technical direction for embodied research at SpAItial.

  • Close the sim-to-real gap through domain randomization, system identification, and calibration, and build evaluation that predicts real-world transfer.

  • Adapt VLM backbones for control: encoder choice and adapter strategies, co-training.

  • Curate and weight the training mix across heterogeneous robot datasets

description:
Wil jij werken voor een fantastisch merk waar je direct impact kunt maken? Ben jij een digital marketing professional met een passie voor food en retail, en voel jij je thuis in een internationale omgeving? Dan is dit jouw kans.

Wat is jouw bijdrage aan het succes van KFC?
Jij bent verantwoordelijk voor het commerciële succes en de continue optimalisatie van het kiosk-kanaal van KFC Nederland. Met behulp van data-analyse, klantinzichten en nauwe samenwerking met verschillende teams zorg je voor meer gebruik van de kiosken, hogere omzet, betere conversie en een hogere gemiddelde besteding per gast.

Jouw volgende uitdaging begint hier

Als Digital Channel Manager (Kiosk) maak je deel uit van het Digital Team van KFC en speel je een belangrijke rol in onze digitale toekomst. Jij bent de drijvende kracht achter de commerciële prestaties en voortdurende optimalisatie van onze self-service kiosken in de restaurants.

Je pakt nieuwe zaken snel op, bent nieuwsgierig van aard en weet klant- en prestatiegegevens moeiteloos te vertalen naar heldere acties en verbeteringen.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Je bent eigenaar van één van KFC's belangrijkste digitale verkoopkanalen en hét aanspreekpunt voor alles rondom de kiosken. Je monitort en verbetert het gebruik, de omzet, conversie en de gemiddelde besteding per gast.

  • Je creëert een eenvoudige, snelle en intuïtieve klantreis, terwijl je tegelijkertijd zorgt voor gebruiksgemak voor onze restaurantteams.

  • Je stelt business requirements op, coördineert testtrajecten en ondersteunt de implementatie van verbeteringen aan de kiosken in samenwerking met het regionale productteam, IT, Operations en technologiepartners.

  • Je signaleert kansen om prestaties te verbeteren door dashboards te monitoren en nauw

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
Before you read further

HelloPrint is on a mission to become the world's leading infrastructure for customizable printed products. From our offices in Rotterdam and Valencia, 100+ professionals from 20+ nationalities are building an AI-first company that scales output faster than headcount. We're at EUR 100M revenue and aiming to disrupt a trillion-dollar industry. Every hire we make needs to help get us there.

  • Commercial instinct first, engineering second. You think about what something is worth before you think about how to build it.

  • Full-time in Rotterdam. Five days a week, in the building where the transformation is happening. This is not negotiable.

  • Always on mentality. This is not a 40-hour job; it’s a deliberate choice into something big that requires “what it takes”

  • You have been building since before it was a career. Side projects, tools, systems nobody asked for. The obsession came first.

  • You ship continuously. You ship fast and you ship real systems. Not prototypes, not demos.

  • You are more than just an engineer. You understand product decisions, user impact, and design tradeoffs. You do not need a PM to translate the business problem for you.

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE & AI Platform Operations)
description:
HelloPrint is mid-transformation. The entire platform is being rebuilt from the ground up: new frontend, new pricing engine, new content engine, new product engine. Everything agent-ready. We ship in a week what used to take a year. What we do not yet have is someone who owns the reliability of all of it: the SLOs, the cost, the AI runtime, and the guardrails that let product engineers move fast without breaking things. That is this role.

Core Objective: Take full technical ownership of production reliability, distributed observability, deployment safety, cost optimization, and AI runtime infrastructure across high-velocity microservices and cloud workloads.


What you will do:

  • SLOs & Error Budgets: Define, track, and enforce Service Level Objectives (SLOs), Service Level Indicators (SLIs), and error-budget policies across core customer journeys and critical services (including checkout, payments, catalog pipelines, and routing engines).

  • Distributed Observability & Telemetry: Expand Telemetry, Sentry + Google Cloud Monitoring distributed tracing, and automated diagnostic tooling across microservices, Laravel Horizon queue workers on Redis, and Google Cloud infrastructure.

  • Deployment Safety & Progressive Delivery: Partner with product teams to evolve CI/CD pipelines with canary traffic shifting, automated SLO-driven rollbacks, and automated health gates in GitHub Actions.

  • AI Platform Operations & FinOps

title: Rail Coordinator (2)
description:
PULL FORWARD, FULL FORCE

Purpose of the position
Are you levelheaded and can you keep an good overview? Do you want a responsible job where you won't get bored for a moment? Then step into the world of rail freight.

We are happy to train you to become an Rail Coördinator at Rail Force One.

As a Rail Coordinator, you are the one who is in control and keeps our trains moving. You will be in close contact with train drivers, traffic control posts, customers and terminals. Even our German colleagues will be informed by you in the event of cross-border traffic. Your communication ensures that all parties are continuously informed of the latest developments.

As the first point of contact, you will play a crucial role in solving questions and challenges. You don't do this alone, but as part of a close-knit team. The Operations department works 24/7 in shifts to keep everything running smoothly. We work two early, two late and two night shifts, followed by four days off.

What are you going to do?

  • Process notifications for ports, trains, and terminals;

  • Carefully enter all data into various systems;

  • Keeping customers and suppliers up-to-date on the train run;

  • Flexible switching in the event of delays and rescheduling if necessary;

  • Smooth communication via phone, email and teams;

  • Establish clear handovers to ensure continuity;

  • Keep an eye on our pool car park;

  • Prepare instructions for train drivers;

  • Assis

title: Werkstudentin Social Media Marketing (m/w/d)
description:
Wir sind Sustainable Med, eine junge Privatpraxis für orthopädische Behandlung, Diagnostik und Prävention in Berlin. Unser Arzt Jan betreut Patient:innen mit Schmerzen am Bewegungsapparat genauso wie Bundesliga-Profis. Wir begleiten Menschen über Monate, messen Fortschritte und bleiben dran, bis das Ziel erreicht ist.

Wir stehen ganz am Anfang. Die Praxis wächst gerade auf zwei Standorte, das Team wird größer, und unsere Marke entsteht in diesen Monaten. Auf Instagram, TikTok und YouTube gibt es bisher kaum etwas von uns. Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel: Du bist die erste Person im Team, die sich voll auf Content und Growth konzentriert und unsere Kanäle von 0 auf 1 bringt.

Warum diese Stelle besonders ist

  • Du baust von 0 auf 1. Redaktionsplan, Formate, Look und Tonalität entstehen mit dir. Was du in den ersten Monaten aufbaust, wird das Fundament unserer Marke.

  • Du übernimmst viel Verantwortung. Content, Kanäle, Community, Events und Partnerschaften treibst du gemeinsam mit uns voran, von der Idee bis zum Reporting. Du berichtest an Jakob, legst mit ihnen Ziele und Prioritäten fest und bekommst regelmäßig Feedback.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit allen drei Gründern. Jeder bringt ein anderes Profil mit: Jan als Arzt, der mit Profisportler:innen arbeitet, Jakob aus Produkt und Marketing, Kristof aus der Beratung und dem Aufbau von Gesundheitseinrichtungen. Du lernst Medizin, Brand-Building und Unternehmensaufbau aus erster Hand.

  • Du bist mitten im Geschehen. Du bist regelmäßig in unseren Praxen vor Ort, erlebst Behandlung, Diagnostik und Training aus nächster Nähe und machst die Menschen dahinter sichtbar.

  • Du wächst mit. Wenn es funktioniert, besteht die Möglichkeit auf eine Stelle nach dem Abschluss in einer schnell wachenden Organisation.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Data Search (remote, Europe)
description:
Hey, I'm Adrian. I’m hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join the Data Search team at Modash.

Modash helps brands find, understand, and work with creators across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube. More than 2,700 companies (including Stanley 1913, Sennheiser, and NordVPN) use us to manage and scale their creator partnerships.

Every one of those products depends on fresh, reliable creator data. Data Core owns the systems that collect and maintain profiles for 400M+ creators across social platforms, process billions of data points, and keep the rest of Modash supplied with the raw material it needs.

That’s where you come in.

Why we're hiring

Search at Modash isn't an internal platform or a support function. It is one of the core products customers use to discover creators.

The scale is large, the data is messy, and the search intent is often complex. A customer might be looking for creators in a specific niche, people whose content conveys a certain visual style, or accounts that resemble a group they already know. Solving that well requires more than adding another filter or calling an LLM API.

We need a senior engineer who can work across the full retrieval system, from data and indexing pipelines to embeddings, ranking, relevance, and low-latency serving, and take ambiguous product problems all the way to production.

You’ll join the specialised Data Search team and work closely with Data Core, Data Insights, product teams, customers, and company leadership. You’ll have real autonomy, but you won’t work in isolation.

If you want a feel for how we think about building software, check our Engineering Blog.

What you'll actually own

1. Make creator search meaningfull

title: Intelligence Center X Principal - EMEA
description:
The ICX Principal sits within the global ICX Engineering practice and represents the most experienced technical and industry expertise across ICX.

Principals bring deep industry knowledge, full-stack command of ICX and the wider Siemens portfolio, and senior relationships across R&D and Siemens leadership that enable them to unblock challenges beyond the reach of an individual deal team.

The role combines deep technical expertise, industry perspective and senior stakeholder engagement to help shape the most strategic ICX opportunities and establish approaches that can be applied more broadly across the practice.


Requirements

Technical

  • Full-stack solution architecture: Designs end-to-end data, AI and application solutions and remains hands-on in the build.
  • Ontology and knowledge-graph design: A plus, but not required. Where present, experience should extend to production-scale implementations.

    • Commercial & Organizational

    • Competitive positioning: Able to position ICX against Databricks, Snowflake and Palantir in front of a customer in a live deal.
    • Use-case identification and value engineering: Finds where the value is in an account, builds the business case with the customer, and establishes value patterns that the zones can reuse.
    • Executive presence and internal reach: Brings gravitas with senior stakeholders and can navigate and mobilize a large organization to unblock a deal.
    • Industry depth: A plus rather than a requirement for every hire. Across the ten Principals, we want meaningful depth across our core industries: automotive, aerospace, industrial machinery, electronics and pharma

  • Tijdens een afstudeeropdracht ligt de nadruk meer op onderzoek en onderbouwing. Je analyseert de informatiebehoefte, onderzoekt methoden voor kennismodellering en valideert jouw concept op bruikbaarheid en effectiviteit.

Je werkzaamheden kunnen onder andere bestaan uit:

title: Stage Elektrotechniek: Decentrale drives
description:

Binnen Voortman Steel Machinery ga je aan de slag met een technische onderzoeksopdracht voor de FAB iX, onze automatische lasrobot. De kern van deze opdracht is het onderzoeken of het technisch, praktisch en economisch haalbaar is om de huidige centrale drives in de machine te vervangen door decentrale drives, inclusief een onderbouwde vergelijking tussen beide oplossingen.

Op dit moment bevindt een groot aantal drives zich gecentraliseerd in de MCC (besturingskast) van de FAB iX. Om vloerruimte te besparen en machines meer modulematig te kunnen bouwen en testen, is de wens om deze drives te verplaatsen naar het veld, in de vorm van decentrale drives. Dit vraagt om inzicht in de technische consequenties, kosten en toepasbaarheid binnen de bestaande machinearchitectuur.

Tijdens deze stageopdracht voer je een haalbaarheidsstudie uit waarbij je onderzoekt of een decentrale aandrijfarchitectuur binnen de FAB iX realiseerbaar is. Daarbij kijk je onder andere naar:

  • Geschikte decentrale drive‑series met verschillende beschermingsklassen (IP65 / IP66 / IP67);

  • De integratie met het bestaande besturingssysteem (PLC en fieldbus);

  • Vermogenseisen en beschikbare varianten;

  • Montageopties, zoals montage op de motor of wandmontage;

  • Beschikbare veiligheidsfuncties, waaronder STO, SLS en vergelijkbare functies.

Je vertaalt deze analyse naar een technische haalbaarheidsstudie en maakt een kostenvergelijking tussen centrale en decentrale drives. De resultaten werk je uit in een eindverslag waarin je je conclusies onderbouwt en duidelijke aanbevelingen formuleert voor eventuele vervolgstappen.
