title: Stage of afstuderen: Interaction Design XR UX/UI
description:
Wat ga je doen?

Tijdens deze stage ga je aan de slag met het ontwerpen van gebruikerservaringen voor XR-oplossingen, zoals LogicSteel XR en andere augmented en virtual reality toepassingen. Binnen deze context werk je aan innovatieve prototypes waarin interactie, gebruiksvriendelijkheid en ruimtelijk inzicht centraal staan. Je onderzoekt hoe gebruikers navigeren en handelen binnen een 3D-omgeving en vertaalt dit naar concrete UX/UI ontwerpen.

Je ontwikkelt en test interactieve prototypes in Unity 3D en werkt deze iteratief uit. Op basis van inzichten uit gebruik, testen en feedback verfijn je jouw ontwerpen en optimaliseer je de interactie. Je werkt hierbij nauw samen met een multidisciplinair ontwikkelteam en volgt jouw concepten van eerste schets tot werkend prototype.

Concreet ga je je bezighouden met:

  • Het ontwerpen van UX/UI concepten voor XR-headsets en 3D interactie;

  • Het bouwen van interactieve prototypes in Unity 3D;

  • Het testen en iteratief verbeteren van gebruikerservaringen;

  • Het onderbouwen van ontwerpkeuzes op basis van gebruikersinzichten;

  • Het opleveren van een werkend en gevalideerd XR prototype.

Het resultaat van jouw stage is een interactief prototype in Unity 3D, inclusief onderbouwde ontwerpkeuzes, dat bijdraagt aan de verdere ontwikkeling van XR-oplossingen binnen de organisatie.

title: Software Engineer C# Machines
description:
Wat ga je doen?

Als Software Engineer C# Machines werk je binnen een van onze machineteams aan de ontwikkeling van nieuwe bewerkingsmachines. Je ontwikkelt software voor de logische laag van onze machines: de intelligentie die bepaalt wat een machine doet, hoe processen verlopen en hoe verschillende functies samenwerken. Daarbij los je dagelijks technisch uitdagende vraagstukken op. Hoe zorg je ervoor dat meerdere bewerkingen optimaal op elkaar aansluiten? Hoe automatiseer je complexe processen zodat de machine efficiënter, slimmer en gebruiksvriendelijker wordt? Dit zijn de vraagstukken waar jij je mee bezighoudt.

Het bijzondere aan deze rol is dat je niet alleen software ontwikkelt, maar ook ziet wat jouw werk in de praktijk doet. Je vertaalt ideeën en concepten naar werkende functionaliteiten die uiteindelijk zichtbaar worden in een fysieke machine. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan het ontwikkelen van slimme software die bepaalt in welke volgorde staalbewerkingen worden uitgevoerd door een of meerdere machines voor maximale productiviteit. Software speelt daarbij een belangrijke rol binnen Voortman. Het is één van de strategische pijlers van onze organisatie en een belangrijk onderdeel van hoe onze machines zich onderscheiden in de markt.

Je werkt nauw samen met collega’s uit verschillende disciplines, zoals PLC Software Engineers, Software Test Engineers, Mechanical Engineers en Electrical Engineers. Daarbij is het belangrijk om de scheiding tussen de softwarelagen helder te houden. Als C# Software Engineer richt jij je op de logische besturing en functionaliteit van de machine. De directe aansturing van hardware, motoren en I/O verloopt via PLC-software, ontwikkeld door onze PLC Software Engineers. Tegelijkertijd werk je regelmatig samen op het snijvlak van beide vakgebieden om machines optimaal te laten functioneren. Omdat de ontwikkeling van een nieuwe machine gemiddeld twee jaar duurt, werk je langdurig aan uitdagende technische vraagstuk

title: Supply Chain Engineer
description:
Wat ga je doen?

Als Supply Chain Engineer speel je een belangrijke rol in het optimaliseren van de materiaalbeschikbaarheid binnen onze organisatie. Je zorgt ervoor dat materialen tijdig beschikbaar zijn voor productie, interne klanten en intercompany locaties. Daarbij werk je op het snijvlak van supply chain, productieplanning en inkoop. Met behulp van data-analyses en MRP-gegevens signaleer je risico’s, afwijkingen en verbeterkansen en onderneem je actie om de continuïteit van de supply chain te waarborgen.

Je vertaalt klantvraag en forecastinformatie naar een haalbare materiaalplanning en bewaakt daarbij de balans tussen beschikbaarheid, voorraadniveaus en leverbetrouwbaarheid. In deze functie combineer je operationele werkzaamheden met een sterk verbetergerichte blik. Je onderzoekt processen, analyseert prestaties en neemt initiatieven om materiaalstromen en planningsprocessen verder te optimaliseren.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • Het controleren van MRP-runs en analyseren van exceptionlijsten om materiaalbehoeften en risico’s inzichtelijk te maken;

  • Het verzamelen, analyseren en rapporteren van supply chain KPI’s;

  • Het beheren en verbeteren van masterdata zoals lead times, stuklijsten en planningsparameters;

  • Het vertalen van klantvraag, forecastgegevens en productiebehoeften naar een haalbare materiaalplanning;

  • Het bewaken van materiaalbeschikbaarheid voor productie, intercompany locaties en interne stakeholders;

  • Het afstemmen met inkoop over leveringen en leveranciersprestaties;

  • Het samenwerken met productieplanning over capaciteit, prioriteiten en de optimale volgorde van werkzaamheden;

  • Het initiëren en realiseren van verbeteringen binnen materiaalstromen, voorraadbeheer en MRP-processen.

description:

Als Business Development Representative ondersteun je onze internationale Business Development activiteiten. Je richt je op het identificeren en benaderen van potentiële klanten in Scandinavië, de Baltische staten, het Verenigd Koninkrijk en andere markten waar Engels een zakelijke voertaal is. Vanuit een gestructureerde werkwijze werk je met moderne sales tools en een helder proces om nieuwe marktkansen in kaart te brengen.

Je hebt veel contact met internationale bedrijven en bent een belangrijke schakel tussen potentiële klanten en onze salesorganisatie. In deze bijbaan ontwikkel je vaardigheden op het gebied van business development, internationale communicatie, leadgeneratie en commerciële gesprekken. Je werkt nauw samen met het Business Development team en krijgt begeleiding om je verder te ontwikkelen binnen outbound sales.

title: Solution Architect Commerce

Wat ga je doen?

De commerciële processen van Voortman worden steeds digitaler en internationaler. Om onze groei en ambities te ondersteunen, investeren we continu in de verdere ontwikkeling van ons commerciële applicatielandschap. title: Strategic Product Manager Service
description:
Wat ga je doen?

Als Strategic Product Manager Service ontwikkel en positioneer je het servicedomein Improve & Advise. Je bouwt aan een portfolio van datagedreven serviceproposities, advies- en productiviteitsdiensten waarmee klanten hun productieproces beter begrijpen, gerichter verbeteren en toekomstige prestaties betrouwbaarder voorspellen. Om tot waardevolle adviezen te komen, kijk je verder dan de afzonderlijke machine. Je analyseert hoe werkvoorbereiding, planning, materiaalstromen, machinegebruik, operators, onderhoud, kwaliteit en output elkaar beïnvloeden. Als onderdeel hiervan combineer je observaties op de werkvloer met machine-, software, service en productiedata. Samen met klanten breng je de feitelijke werkwijze, knelpunten en economische impact in kaart. Zo maak je zichtbaar waar capaciteit verloren gaat en waarom prestaties afwijken. Vervolgens vertaal je deze inzichten naar scherpe probleemdefinities, concrete verbeterhypotheses, nieuwe serviceproposities en relevante KPI’s.

 

De vertaling van analyse naar actie vormt de kern van Improve & Advise. Door analyses en resultaten te standaardiseren, bouw je samen met de organisatie aan benchmarks, adviesmethoden, voorspellende inzichten en serviceproposities. title: Afstuderen Software: Automatisch inmeten
description:
Wat ga je doen?

Voordat een plaat bewerkt kan worden, moet een machine exact weten waar deze zich bevindt. Op dit moment gebeurt een groot deel van dit inmeetproces nog handmatig. Dat kost tijd en vraagt aandacht van de operator terwijl die zich liever richt op het productieproces. Tijdens deze afstudeeropdracht ontwikkel jij een oplossing waarmee het inmeten van platen verder geautomatiseerd wordt, zodat de machine zelfstandig en betrouwbaar de exacte positie van een plaat kan bepalen.

Een belangrijk onderdeel van de opdracht is de interactie tussen operator en machine. Jij onderzoekt en ontwikkelt een gebruiksvriendelijke oplossing waarmee een operator tijdens het productieproces kan aangeven waar een plaat zich ongeveer bevindt, zonder de machine hiervoor te hoeven bewegen. Zodra de plaat aan de beurt is voor bewerking, start de machine automatisch jouw ontwikkelde inmeetroutine. Hierdoor hoeft de operator niet meer aanwezig te zijn tijdens het meten en ontstaat meer ruimte voor voorbereiding en onbemande productie.

Je komt terecht binnen het multidisciplinaire Plates-team van Voortman in Rijssen. Hier werk je samen met softwareontwikkelaars en engineers aan innovatieve oplossingen voor plaatbewerkingsmachines. Binnen deze omgeving krijg je de vrijheid om onderzoek te doen, concepten uit te werken, software te ontwikkelen en jouw oplossing direct in een praktijkomgeving te testen. Je werkt daarbij op het eigen softwareplatform VACAM en doet ervaring op met industriële automatisering, machinebesturing en softwareontwikkeling.


Wij vragen

  • HBO- of WO-student Software Engineering, Computer Science of vergelijkbare technische opleiding;

  • interesse in softwareontwikkeling, machinebesturing en industriële automatisering;

  • analytisch sterk en in staat om complexe technische

title: Stage PLC Software: Ontwikkeling Labelmachine
description:
Wat ga je doen?

Binnen deze stageopdracht ga je aan de slag met het werkend krijgen van een automatische labelmachine voor stalen profielen. Je werkt aan een fysieke prototype-opstelling waarin je jouw software direct kunt testen en valideren. Een bestaande labelmachine wordt gekoppeld aan een lineaire as met servomotor, waarmee de labelmachine nauwkeurig boven een conveyor kan bewegen. Over deze conveyor worden stalen profielen getransporteerd die automatisch van een label moeten worden voorzien.

Jij ontwikkelt de aansturing van dit systeem. Met behulp van sensoren bepaal je de positie van bewegende profielen en zorg je ervoor dat de labelmachine op het juiste moment de juiste positie bereikt. De besturing wordt gerealiseerd in een Beckhoff PLC met TwinCAT. Daarnaast zet je de communicatie tussen de PLC en de labelmachine op en zorg je ervoor dat alle componenten betrouwbaar samenwerken.

Je bent betrokken bij het volledige proces: van het uitlezen van sensoren, het programmeren van de besturing tot het testen, optimaliseren en inbedrijfstellen van de oplossing. Hierdoor doe je praktijkervaring op met industriële automatisering, PLC-programmering, motion control, sensortechniek en machine-integratie. Je werkt zelfstandig aan een oplossing die direct toepasbaar is binnen de machinebouw.


Wij vragen

  • Een hbo- of wo-opleiding in de richting van Mechatronica, Electrotechniek, Industriële Automatisering of vergelijkbaar;

  • Proactieve werkhouding en een praktische instelling;

  • Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse of Engelse taal.

Wij bieden

  • Een vergoeding: €600,- per maand;

  • Reiskostenvergoeding: zodat jij geen onnodige kosten maakt;

We're looking for a Principal Product Security Engineer to shape how we design, build, and ship secure software at Tellent.

You'll work alongside our engineering leads and closely with our existing Security and GRC team. They own corporate security policy, certification, risk and incident response; you'll focus on product security, close to our engineers, architecture and code.

This isn't a gatekeeper role. Your impact will come from partnering with teams, building trust, and creating solutions that make the secure way the easiest way to build.

Iedereen verdient een eerlijke kans om te groeien en beloond te worden voor wat hij of zij bijdraagt. Toch wordt in veel organisaties nog beoordeeld op onderbuikgevoel.

Daar gaan wij verandering in brengen. Learned maakt evalueren, ontwikkelen en belonen eerlijk, transparant en uitlegbaar. Zo hebben leidinggevenden meer tijd voor de gesprekken die er echt toe doen.

Meer dan 350 organisaties werken al met Learned. Met loontransparantie in aantocht staat eerlijk belonen hoger op de agenda dan ooit. Ons doel: een eerlijkere arbeidsmarkt in Nederland. Bouw je mee?

Partnerships is bij ons een nieuw kanaal. De eerste partners zijn aangesloten en de eerste successen zijn er. Maar hoe we samen marketing doen, staat nog grotendeels open.

En dat is precies de kans. Jij bepaalt hoe partnership marketing bij Learned eruitziet. Je hebt geen draaiboek om te volgen, want jij schrijft het.

Je ziet bij elke nieuwe partner meteen waarom we samen sterker zijn, en voor wie. Je giet dat in een plan, enthousiasmeert de partner en zorgt dat het van kick-off tot resultaat loopt. Het ene moment denk je strategisch, het volgende regel je zelf de eventlocatie.

title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer, Insurance Platform
description:
ABOUT INSIFY

We sell a mix of insurance products to small businesses (SME's) in the Netherlands, Germany and France, and we are in the process of scaling into more markets. 

Insurance infrastructure is brutal to get right. Every carrier has its own spec, every product its own underwriting rules, every country its own regulatory requirements. Most insurers throw people and process at that complexity - one-off integrations, workarounds on workarounds. We're building it differently: our insurance platform is where we consolidate that complexity, so that launching a new product or market becomes a configuration exercise rather than a rebuild.

Insify is a high-growth scale-up backed by more than €40M from investors like Accel, Munich Re Ventures, and Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg. In five years we've expanded from the Netherlands into France and Germany. Our mission: become the European leader in AI-powered SME insurance.


About the role

You would join the Insurance Platform team, responsible for everything that happens after a small business buys a policy from us. You would take technical leadership in that team, and shape how the platform handles the next product and the next country, on a system already carrying live policies and real customers.

The team owns end-to-end policy lifecycle management (mid-term adjustments, automated renewals, cancellations, and payment flows) alongside the backoffice tooling that gives our operations and support teams full visibility and control. We work closely with the Claims Team, and with the Activation Teams that turn a lead into a paying customer. Product and engineering together are 30+ people.

Every country has its own regulatory quirks, and every insurance product has unique data structures, lifecycle rules, and money flows.

As we expand across Europe, our goal isn't to write custom glue code for every new launch.

title: Compliance Engineer
description:
About Playson

Playson builds premium casino games and platform solutions for operators worldwide. Our products reach millions of players across regulated markets, and we ship frequently - which means our certification and compliance evidence has to be as well-engineered as the games themselves.

We are hiring a Software Developer, Compliance, to own that engineering: a pipeline that lets us ship faster and safer, and a defence of the platform and the games that holds up in front of a lab, an ISO assessor, and a future SOC 2 auditor.

About the role

You are a software developer sitting inside compliance. You will build and continuously evolve a secure compliance pipeline so we can ship games and platform changes faster and safer - and you will be the technical person who defends what we shipped when an auditor, a certification lab, or a regulator asks.

The scope is not games alone. You will stand in front of game certification labs, and you will also defend the platform: ISO certification of our systems and the evidence work that leads into a future SOC 2 audit. In every case, the job is the same. You produce the proof. You walk the auditor through it. You answer the question that was asked, with the evidence that was requested, and you stop there.

You will own the technical side of game certification. You take a game math package from the review channel to the lab, you produce the evidence the lab needs - build hashes, PAR sheets, configuration snapshots, version manifests - and you answer the lab's technical questions yourself, without a developer sitting next to you. When a certificate comes back, you are the person who confirms every deficiency is closed before the game is allowed past the pre-release gate.

Between lab submissions, you treat the pipeline as a product. Manual evidence collection, one-off screenshots, and tribal knowledge are the things you replace. You automate controls, tighten the audit trail, and shorten the path from "ready to ship" to "ready to show an auditor" without weakening the bar. Faster and safer at the same time is the point of this role - not one at the expense of the other.

What we're looking for

  • You are a developer first. 3+ years writing production code, comfortable reading someone else's codebase and forming your own opinion about what it does. You are not a documentation coordinator who learned some technical words

  • Strong Node.js and TypeScript. Our game math packages, engine integration, rules and bets migrations, test suites, and compliance automation are all JavaScript-side. You will read game math code and verify that what it does matches what we told the lab it does - and you will write the tooling that makes that check repeatable

title: Staff Product Security Engineer
description:
Who are we?

At UpGuard, we are replacing manual security bottlenecks with AI-driven precision. Fresh off a US$75M Series C, we are scaling our infrastructure to process 100 billion risk signals daily. This isn’t just growth; it’s a total reimagining of how the world manages cyber risk.

We build the Cyber Risk Posture Management (CRPM) platform that security teams actually love. By integrating security ratings, threat intel, and agentic AI, we empower organisations to stay ahead of an ever evolving attack surface.

We aren’t just building another tool; we’re defining a category. We provide the autonomy to ship world-class technology and the resources to do it at a global scale.

You won't be inheriting someone else's decisions. You'll be defining the security standards, tooling, and practices that protect UpGuard's products and infrastructure for years to come.

In this role, you'll work across our product and production environments: performing security reviews, managing vulnerabilities, and running detection and response operations in our cloud-native infrastructure. You'll collaborate closely with our product engineering and platform teams to secure our products, CI/CD pipelines, and production systems, and to embed security into how we build from the ground up.

  • Lead threat modelling and security reviews across UpGuard's product portfolio and cloud infrastructure, proactively surfacing attack vectors and designing mitigation strategies that scale with growth.

  • Build automation, policy-as-code, and AI-driven security tooling that lets product engineering teams "shift left" and embeds security across the SDLC, leveraging agentic workflows to triage, review, and scale the reach of a lean security function.

  • Design and implement secure-by-default configurations for cloud and Kubernetes infrastruct

Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

  1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

  2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

  • Manage the opening, maintenance, and closure of correspondent bank accounts within the ICBC group.

  • Support ICBC European institutions in joining local Euro clearing organizations.

  • Prepare statistical reports on clearing operations to support business development.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.

title: Python Engineer – Web Crawling & Data Extraction (m/f/d)

About the Job

We build and operate large-scale web crawling and extraction systems that turn unstructured, dynamic websites into clean, structured and correct data.   • Design and operate pipelines for ingestion, deduplication, versioning and enrichment.
  • Ship and run containerized apps in the cloud, with CI/CD.
  • Shape our technical architecture and engineering culture.


Our Tech Stack

Python, Docker, GCP (Cloud Run jobs), Azure Blob Storage, MongoDB. Go services and a React frontend on the periphery. You don't need all of it on day one, but you do need to ramp up fast.


Your profile

At Quantum Systems, we are building highly autonomous interceptor systems that must perceive, decide, and act under extreme latency, motion, and environmental constraints.

You will work on low-latency camera pipelines, small-object detection, object tracking, sensor fusion, visual odometry, precision landing, camera calibration, embedded inference, and data pipelines for training and validation.

Your Mission

You will develop the vision and AI pipeline that turns raw camera data into actionable perception outputs for autonomous flight.   • Bring up, optimize, and maintain high-performance camera pipelines, including CSI camera interfaces, raw image access, buffering, synchronization, and latency reduction.

  • Fuse inertial data, motion information, and visual data to improve

Reporting to the Senior Customer Service Manager, you'll join a highly specialised team of experts who partner closely with Legal, Risk, and Corporate Affairs to manage sensitive escalations, including matters from the Tolling Customer Ombudsman and government ministers.     As our Customer Specialist Support Manager, you'll contribute to lasting and positive changes that shape the future of our cities and communities. It's meaningful, challenging, and exciting work.      Day-to-day, you will:     Lead, coach, and mentor a team of Team Leaders and Senior Specialists who handle our highest-risk, most complex escalations, building their capability and creating a high-performance culture driven by data and analytical rigour.  Provide strategic oversight for our most sensitive customer escalations, ensuring that Ombudsman, Ministerial, executive, and media-related matters are resolved with a balance of customer empathy, commercial sense, and reputational care.  Use your strong analytical skills to monitor performance, manage backlogs, and dive deep into complaint data to identify root causes and drive business-wide process improvements.  Act as the key point of contact for senior internal stakeholders, providing clear, data-driven reporting and insights on trends, risks, and team performance.       This role will suit someone with a curious mind and transferrable skills and experiences, including:     Proven leadership experience in managing both Team Leaders and highly specialised technical experts within a complex, high-volume customer service, advocacy, complaints, or dispute resolution environment.  Previous experience working within a large, highly regulated organisations (such as banking, telecommunications, or utilities) with a deep familiarity with complex policy frameworks and dispute resolution processes.  A hands-on, highly analytical approach. You are a "numbers person" who is regimented about watching performance metrics daily, proactively managing backlogs, and translating raw operational data into clear executive reports and business cases.  Direct, practical experience managing sensitive, high-stakes customer escalations, including partnering with Legal, Risk, and Corporate Affairs to resolve Ombudsman disputes, ministerial inquiries, and high-profile, media-related complaints.  A dedicated coaching style that leads by example, focusing on mentorship, employee engagement, and performance management to build strong capability and confidence within your leadership team.  A focus on practical delivery and implementation, bringing a proven track record of translating complex insights from complaints into systemic, real-world solutions that drive business-wide process improvements. title: Customer Support Team Lead
description: About The Role   We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Customer Support Team Leader to join our team. As the Customer Support Team Lead, you will be responsible for leading a team of Customer Support Consultants, ensuring they deliver outstanding service to our clients. You will play a critical role in maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction, resolving technical issues, and providing strategic support to our valued customers.  This is a permanent full-time position in either our Perth CBD office headquarters. This position is in-office; however, it allows for ad hoc working from home.  The Customer Support Team Lead will have experience in application support in the mining industry and a proven history of driving a high performing, customer-centric team culture. To achieve excellent customer outcomes, the Team Lead will be required to work directly with end users of these products and with various teams across our global business.  Candidates with prior experience in RPM’s software or mining software applications will be highly regarded. Ensure team adherence to customer support policies, procedures, and best practices to enhance service delivery.   Monitor and analyse support metrics to identify trends and areas for improvement.   Collaborate with other departments, including Product Development, Consulting and Sales, to ensure a seamless customer experience. Handle escalated customer inquiries and complaints, ensuring timely and satisfactory resolution.   Prepare and present reports on team performance and customer feedback to senior management. Strong technical knowledge of software applications and troubleshooting.   Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with customers and colleagues.   Proven ability to lead and motivate a team in a fast-paced environment.   Strong problem-solving skills and a customer-centric approach. title: Service Manager - Zakelijke Markt / B2B
description: Dit ga je doen     Maak het verschil voor onze zakelijke klanten    Bij Odido geloven we dat technologie pas écht waardevol wordt als mensen er beter van worden. Daarom bouwen we niet alleen aan een sterk en betrouwbaar netwerk, maar vooral aan een dienstverlening die het verschil maakt voor onze klanten. Persoonlijk, betrokken en altijd met de ambitie om het morgen nóg beter te doen.  Voor onze Enterprise-klanten is connectiviteit essentieel. Zij vertrouwen iedere dag op onze diensten om hun organisatie draaiende te houden. Dat vraagt om meer dan goede technologie en duidelijke afspraken. Het vraagt om mensen die begrijpen wat er bij onze klanten speelt, verantwoordelijkheid nemen en ervoor zorgen dat we onze beloftes waarmaken.  En daar kom jij in beeld.  Als Service Manager ben jij het vaste aanspreekpunt voor een aantal van onze grootste zakelijke klanten. Je bent de verbindende schakel tussen onze klanten en de operationele teams binnen Odido. Je kijkt verder dan contracten en KPI's, bouwt aan sterke relaties en zorgt ervoor dat onze dienstverlening aansluit op wat onze klanten écht nodig hebben.  Want uiteindelijk draait goede dienstverlening om vertrouwen. En dat vertrouwen bouw jij iedere dag verder uit.  Zo draag jij direct bij aan onze ambitie om Customer Champion te worden.   De Rol   Als Service Manager bij Odido ben jij het aanspreekpunt voor jouw portfolio van grote Enterprise-klanten. Je bewaakt onze klantspecifieke contractafspraken, zorgt dat onze dienstverlening aansluit op de verwachtingen en behoeften van klanten en neemt de regie wanneer situaties extra aandacht vragen.   Relatiebeheer staat centraal in alles wat je doet.   Je kent jouw klanten, begrijpt hun organisatie en weet welke diensten voor hen bedrijfskritisch zijn. Je bouwt en onderhoudt sterke relaties en bent zowel intern als extern een waardevolle gesprekspartner op operationeel en tactisch niveau. Je begrijpt de belangen en urgentie van verschillende stakeholders en weet hierin de juiste balans te vinden tussen de klant en Odido.  Je bewaakt de afgesproken SLA's en KPI's en zorgt ervoor dat deze worden nageleefd en waar mogelijk overtroffen. Je houdt onze beheersprocessen scherp in de gaten, werkt punctueel en zorgt ervoor dat afspraken, acties en opvolging goed worden vastgelegd. Proceshygiëne is voor jou vanzelfsprekend.  Je luistert naar onze klanten, verzamelt hun behoeften en feedback en vertaalt deze naar concrete verbeteracties binnen Odido. Je adviseert en ondersteunt klanten over onze dienstverlening, denkt commercieel mee en herkent kansen om onze samenwerking verder te versterken.   En wanneer een klant belt omdat iets niet goed gaat? Dan kom jij direct in actie.   Je schakelt meteen over naar samenwerken en oplossingen realiseren. Je begrijpt de urgentie, communiceert helder en zorgt ervoor dat de juiste mensen betrokken worden.  Als eerste escalatiepunt voor jouw klantportfolio neem jij de regie wanneer incidenten vastlopen in het reguliere proces

title: Service Delivery Manager

title: Executive Assistant
description:
🌍 About Outpost

Global expansion is broken. Without a local entity, conversion rates fall, costs rise, and compliance gets messy. Outpost fixes it.

Outpost is your modular back office for global commerce. Pick only what you need - tax, payments, treasury, or operations - and unlock new markets without the overhead. Sometimes we act as Merchant of Record, taking on tax and compliance risk. Other times, we give you the tools to do it yourself.

Sell anything, anywhere. Without compromise.

🧠 The Role

We're hiring a second Executive Assistant to support our CEO.

We already have an EA, and she isn't going anywhere. You'll report to the CEO and work alongside her: she keeps inbound, customer routing and the investor-facing side, takes diary, travel, logistics, internal admin, and hiring coordination. You'll join to take a defined set of workstreams off that plate.

Roughly 70% of this role is executive support. The other 30% is hiring - and that's where the leverage is. We run a five-stage interview loop across engineering, ops, product, GTM and tax, hiring around two people a month. Someone needs to own the machinery: scheduling across five calendars and four countries, keeping candidates warm, chasing feedback, making sure nobody good goes cold because a diary didn't line up.

This is a role for someone early in their career who is unusually organised and wants to learn how a company actually gets built. You won't be handed a finished process. You'll be shown how we do things today, and expected to make it better.

🧩 What You'll Do

Own the CEO's diary and logistics

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. title: ML Research Engineer - Member of Technical Staff
description:
About Us

We’re living through a Cambrian explosion of intelligence: new models and new chips, each specialised for different tasks, are arriving all at once. The result is a new era for AI, one of radical heterogeneity.

Callosum is the Intelligent Systems Company. We believe the next generation of AI won't be defined by any single model or chip, but by intelligent systems in which hardware and intelligence co-evolve. We are building the infrastructure that unifies heterogeneous compute across the full stack. This opens a new axis of scaling intelligence: a dynamic system that tailors itself to what each workload actually needs, whether that's speed, cost, precision, or whatever unit comes next.

The last era scaled on a different bet: one bigger model, more of the same chip, more data. That bet is running into structural limits. Frontier models offer extraordinary capability at unsustainable cost, one that today's monolithic infrastructure was never designed to serve.

Our founding principle is that intelligence comes from many specialised systems working together, not from any single component. We build the software orchestration layer that co-evolves models, workflows and silicon into one system, delivering inference tailored to every workload, and demonstrating orders-of-magnitude leaps in capability and cost.

Because our software spans the full stack, our engineering team works directly with heterogeneous accelerators and frontier silicon, including Cerebras, d-Matrix, Intel, NVIDIA, AMD, Normal Computing, Tenstorrent, GreatSky, and Mixx. We are not stopping at today's chips: each new generation of silicon unlocks algorithms that couldn't run before, and we intend to be first to them, every time. Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Due to continued growth, internal promotions and an ongoing need to support our expanding customer base, we’re excited to be hiring Customer Service Advisors.

  • Treasury operations.

We are a startup building a platform that is in daily use during patient care, and our direction changes as we learn. What we want to offer you:     A crucial role within a leading veterinary hospital focusing on client service excellence  A large, modern hospital and a workplace that is focused on employee wellbeing and professional satisfaction  Employee benefits including discounts on veterinary services, discounts at retail stores and more!  The chance to make a meaningful impact on client satisfaction and team engagement     APPLY NOW!

 Tines has been supporting IT and security teams from a diverse range of customers, including Canva, Reddit, SAP, Coinbase, Mars, Fin (Intercom), and McKesson. 
 Tines 3B, launched in 2026, is the next generation of Tines – a single, secure environment for every team’s apps, agents and automations. 
 As an integrator across the entire tech stack, Tines is vendor-agnostic integrating with any API-enabled service. This flexibility enables our customers to achieve their highest-priority goals faster. Tines has security woven into its DNA, and our platform is secure and private by design.  
 At Tines, we're driven by our values of Simplicity, Speed, and Soundness. title: Customer Success Associate (Denver, CO)
description:
Headquarters:  Remote
 

  About the Team  
 Netlify's Customer Success team is responsible for making sure customers get real, lasting value from the platform - from onboarding through renewal and beyond. The team works closely with Sales, Product, and Marketing to help customers grow their usage, see clear outcomes, and stay engaged over time. Every motion the team runs - whether it's a renewal conversation, a feature adoption push or customer escalation - is designed to build trust and relationships that compound. 
 This role exists because we have a growing book of SMB accounts that need a dedicated, consistent point of contact. As our Customer Success Associate, you’ll drive broad-stroke outreach and build the workflows to manage them well. You'll carry a book of 120+ accounts with roughly $2M in ARR, and your job is to make sure those customers are engaged, getting value, and set up for renewal. This is an entry-level role with real ownership from day one, and you'll have mentorship from senior teammates as you ramp into the commercial side of the work. 
  What You'll Do  
 
 Own the day-to-day relationship for your book of accounts, serving as the primary point of contact and keeping customers informed, engaged, and successful on the platform 
 Contribute ideas to dashboards and workflows to track your book of business - renewal timelines, health signals, engagement levels, and expansion indicators - so nothing falls through the cracks 
 With guidance of leadership, drive outreach to customers ahead of renewal, lead those conversations, handle objections, and negotiate terms on flat renewals and smaller expansions, looping in Sales when a meaningful expansion opportunity emerges.  
 Track and forecast your renewal book on a rolling basis, proactively surfacing risks and creating plans to address them before they become problems 
 Use product usage data and customer outcomes to demonstrate value in renewal conversations and ongoing check-ins 
 Identify opportunities for feature adoption and product expansion within accounts, and flag those signals to the Sales team to build expansion pipeline 
 Gather and synthesize customer feedback and share it with Product and internal stakeholders to inform roadmap decisions and improve the customer experience 
 Work closely with senior CS teammates and your manager to develop your skills in account management, commercial negotiation, and customer communication 
 
  What You'll Bring  
 
 Some experience in a customer-facing role - this could be internship work, customer service, sales support, retail, or anything that required you to build rapport and solve problems for people 
 Comfort working with data and spreadsheets, and a genuine interest in using that data to spot trends and make decisions 
 A track record of following through: when you commit to something, you close the loop 
 Clear written and verbal communication - you can explain things simply, listen well, and adapt your approach

title: Senior Pre- & Post-Sales Customer Engineer, Enterprise
description:
Headquarters:  San Francisco, CA / Seattle, WA / Denver, CO / Remote
 

 The Team + The Role 
 Pendo’s Customer Engineering team is the technical backbone of the pre- and post-sales customer motion. The team brings together work that has historically sat across Customer Success, Technical Account Management, and Solutions Engineering into one full-lifecycle technical owner. Customer Engineering helps customers connect technical execution to business outcomes and realize the value of their investment in Pendo. 
 As a Senior Customer Engineer, you own strategic and complex Enterprise accounts across acquisition, implementation, adoption, expansion, and escalation. You lead technical strategy for complex deployments, resolve ambiguous customer challenges, and partner closely with account teams to drive retention, expansion, and customer value. Your impact extends beyond your own accounts through playbooks, coaching, repeatable fixes, and workflow improvements that raise the capability of the broader Customer Engineering team. 
 This is a remote role supporting a West Coast territory.  
 What this looks like day-to-day 
 
  New customer acquisition and selling:  Partner with Account Directors on pre-sales motions for new customer acquisition, product expansion, and expansion across lines of business. You identify customer pain, craft and deliver tailored demos, and lead technical evaluations through requirements gathering, success criteria, installation guidance, and hands-on workshops. 
  Complex implementations and value realization:  Lead onboarding for strategic customers, including planning, implementation, integrations, and training. You build customer-specific implementation playbooks, guide complex deployments with executive visibility, and ensure customers realize value during onboarding and over time. 
  Adoption, expansion, and growth:  Identify opportunities to expand adoption across underutilized features, untapped products, and new lines of business. When adoption stalls, you diagnose root causes, design a path forward, and connect technical work to measurable business outcomes. 
  Technical escalation:  Serve as an escalation point for complex technical challenges raised by other Customer Engineers. You resolve ambiguous problems with multiple variables and tradeoffs, involving Product or Engineering only when truly needed. 
  Team capability building:  Build playbooks, document repeatable fixes, coach peers, and improve how Customer Engineering work gets done across the team. You use AI tools to accelerate content creation, surface patterns across accounts, and share practical workflow findings with the broader team. 
  Early account impact:  Assess account health, risks, stakeholder relationships, and the highest-priority problems to solve within your portfolio. You establish trust with Account Directors and customer stakeholders, then independently lead complex customer interactions that move accounts forward.

description:

  About the Team  
 Netlify is a product-led growth company with an unusually large organic top-of-funnel, where tens of thousands of people discover and sign up for Netlify every day. That organic motion is real and meaningful, but paid acquisition is a new investment area for the marketing team, and there's a clear opportunity to build that capability from the ground up.  
 As Senior Manager, Demand Generation & Performance Marketing, you'll own paid acquisition end to end - strategy, channel selection, budget, and the agency relationship that supports execution. You'll report to the CMO, with a planned transition to the VP of Growth Marketing as that function scales, and work closely with Marketing Operations, Data, Lifecycle, and Campaigns to make sure paid-acquired users don't just land, but convert and stick. This is a builder role at a company where the organic foundation is already strong, and your job is to build the paid layer that extends its reach. 
  What You'll Do  
 
 Build and own Netlify's paid acquisition strategy end to end, including paid search, paid social, retargeting, sponsorships, and any other channels worth testing and proving out.

 Manage the agency relationship(s) supporting paid/performance work by setting the brief, holding the agency accountable to targets, and deciding what to bring in-house as the function matures. 
 Own budget planning, pacing, and ROI reporting for all paid spend, and make the case for where to double down or pull back.

 Build the measurement framework for CAC, signup/pipeline contribution, and payback by channel. 
 Partner with Lifecycle and Campaigns to make sure paid-acquired users flow into the right onboarding and activation journeys, not just land and drop off. 
 As the program proves out, build the roadmap and case for a fully staffed paid/performance team. 
 
  What You'll Bring  
 
 6+ years in demand generation or performance marketing, with direct ownership of a paid acquisition budget in a B2B SaaS or product-led growth environment 
 Hands-on experience running paid search, paid social, and retargeting programs yourself - not just briefing agencies or reviewing their reports 
 A track record of standing up or significantly scaling a paid acquisition program at an early stage, where you had to build the infrastructure and not just optimize what was already there 
 Experience managing an external agency or partner relatio

title: Senior Product Manager - Meta (all genders)
description:
JustPlay is looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Meta product domain and help shape the experience that connects our games with the broader JustPlay platform.

At JustPlay, Meta is the layer between core gameplay and our rewards platform - including progress, rewards, boosters, LiveOps, and the experiences that connect each game to the wider JustPlay ecosystem. The Meta team owns this layer across our full game portfolio, extending platform features into games and building shared, reusable components that can be adopted across multiple titles. This helps us create a consistent player experience and scale new features across the portfolio without rebuilding them game by game.

In this role, you'll focus on making the JustPlay ecosystem feel seamless for players - identifying where the experience breaks between games and platform, turning those gaps into product opportunities, and setting direction around the solutions that can have the greatest impact on our key metrics. You'll work closely with Design, Engineering, Data, and game teams to align around priorities, make trade-offs, and drive outcomes across the ecosystem.

What sets this role apart?

You'll be building for an entire portfolio of 50+ games, not just a single title. That means thinking in systems, balancing the needs of different games and player journeys, and shaping solutions that can scale across the JustPlay ecosystem.

Job Responsibilities

  • Own the product strategy, priorities, and key results for your area within the Meta domain

  • Identify and prioritise high-impact opportunities across the JustPlay ecosystem, balancing player needs, business goals, and technical constrain

title: Senior Sales Controller (All Genders)
description:
YOU & AHEAD

At ahead, we are on a mission to clean up the world's candy drawers. We make the snacks everyone actually craves, reformulated with less sugar and zero compromise on taste. We are 140 people strong, with 170+ SKUs and aggressive growth across D2C, retail, Amazon, and new European markets.

Growth across that many channels only pays off when we know exactly where it comes from. Commercial controlling is where numbers turn into decisions: which customers, channels, products and promotions actually make us money, where the plan is drifting, and what we should do about it. We are building that function to keep pace with our growth.

Are you a hands-on commercial finance professional who owns the numbers, challenges assumptions, and turns insights into action? If so, read on.


YOUR TASKS

  • Sales KPI Reporting: Own reporting on revenue, volume, margin, sell-in/sell-out, distribution, and forecast accuracy, with clear dashboards, early-warning indicators, and a standardized customer and channel P&L.
  • Budgets, Forecasts & Rolling Plans: Build baseline forecasts, challenge input from sales channels in the consolidated demand plan, track plan versus actual, and recommend corrective actions.
